title: Director of Product, Platform
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
**QAD** 
 is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose\-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food \& beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.
   

  

 Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record — ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure — the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain\-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.
   

  

**ERA — QAD's Enterprise Resource Allocation platform —** 
 is the domain intelligence layer that sits between any ERP and any AI agent. It encodes what manufacturing data means, governs what agents are permitted to do, and makes every autonomous decision traceable and accountable.
   

  

**Job Description**
 This role owns a key pillar of ERA — the Manufacturing Data Fabric \& Intelligence layer. This is the foundational intelligence core: the semantic layer that encodes what manufacturing data means, the metric registry that governs how business outcomes are measured, and the AI Insights and conversational analytics capabilities that surface intelligence to users and agents alike. Without this layer, the rest of ERA cannot function. It is the prerequisite for every downstream agent action, every governed decision, and every autonomous workflow ERA enables.
   

  

 As Director of Product for Data, AI, Reporting \& Analytics, you will report directly to the Head of Platform Product and lead a team of Product Managers and Technical Product Owners. Your scope is the intelligence core — not the integration layer, not the governance engine, not the developer API. You will partner closely with the Directors leading those pillars, but your mandate is singular: make manufacturing data meaningful, queryable, and AI\-ready at enterprise scale.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility, high\-leverage role. The semantic layer is ERA's primary moat — the hardest layer to build and the one no horizontal AI platform will invest in replicating. Your roadmap decisions will compound over years and directly determine QAD's competitive positioning in the era of autonomous manufacturing.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Foundation Exists — The Mandate Now Is To Build ERA's Intelligence Core Into The Definitive Manufacturing Ontology Platform. You Will Have The Scope To
   

  

* Define and own the manufacturing semantic layer — encoding supplier criticality, lead time patterns, quality thresholds, and operational constraints in a form AI agents can reason from
* Build the contextual intelligence layer that passes metric definitions, data distributions, and business rules to LLMs for accurate, anomaly\-aware narrative generation
* Drive QAD's conversational analytics strategy — enabling non\-technical manufacturing users to query operations in natural language without SQL or BI expertise
* Establish the AI evaluation framework that governs quality, accuracy, and latency of every AI\-generated insight shipped to enterprise customers
* Evolve the platform from reactive reporting to proactive, agentic intelligence — where the system surfaces recommended actions, not just data


**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Strategy \& Roadmap**
* Own the multi\-year product roadmap for ERA's Manufacturing Data Fabric \& Intelligence layer — from raw data pipeline to user\-facing AI insights
* Define the manufacturing semantic layer: encoding metric definitions, operational constraints, supplier relationships, and business rules into a governed ontology that AI agents can reason from
* Translate QAD's ERA vision into concrete, sequenced product bets for the intelligence core — partnering with Directors leading the Integration, Governance, and API pillars to ensure the full platform coheres
* Lead the evolution of AI Insights capabilities: contextual anomaly detection, plain\-language narrative generation, and agentic root cause analysis


**AI \& Conversational Analytics**
* Drive the conversational analytics product — ontology design, knowledge graph, context graph, and intent detection for natural language querying
* Establish and own the AI evaluation framework: latency, accuracy, relevancy gates, LLM\-as\-judge, and human\-in\-the\-loop oversight
* Architect the contextual layer that passes metadata, data distributions, and business rules to LLMs for accurate, enterprise\-grade output
* Define QAD's approach to agentic AI — moving from reactive Q\&A to proactive, action\-triggering intelligence within ERP workflows


**Enterprise Self\-Service Reporting**
* Own the product strategy for self\-service report building — enabling business users across manufacturing, finance, supply chain, and operations to create, customise, and share reports without engineering dependency
* Define the RBAC model for reporting: row\-level and column\-level access controls, report sharing permissions, data scoping by plant, region, and business unit — ensuring enterprise customers can safely deploy self\-service capabilities across large, complex org structures
* Lead the go\-to\-market and rollout strategy for self\-service reporting across B2B industry verticals — working with Customer Success and Solutions Engineering to drive adoption, define onboarding playbooks, and reduce time\-to\-value for enterprise deployments
* Set the product bar for enterprise\-grade report authoring: scheduling, export, embedding, white\-labelling, and audit trails that meet the compliance and operational needs of regulated industries
* Establish feedback loops with enterprise customers to continuously refine the self\-service experience — tracking adoption metrics, identifying capability gaps, and prioritising the roadmap against real user workflows


**Data Infrastructure \& Intelligence**
* Partner with Engineering to define the data lake, pipeline, and event architecture that underpins ERA's intelligence layer — optimising for AI\-readiness, scale, and cost efficiency
* Own the metric registry and semantic data model — ensuring consistent, governed definitions of manufacturing KPIs across all ERA consumers
* Collaborate with the Governance \& Compliance pillar to ensure intelligence outputs meet enterprise compliance requirements; own the data quality and freshness standards within your layer
* Define monetization strategy for intelligence platform capabilities including governed data exports, delta sharing, and partner integrations


**GTM, Sales \& Market Enablement**
* Act as the product authority for Sales and Marketing on ERA's Data, AI, and Analytics capabilities — providing positioning, messaging, and competitive differentiation across the full intelligence layer, not just reporting
* Partner with GTM teams to develop selling motions for AI Insights, conversational analytics, and self\-service reporting — translating platform capabilities into clear business value narratives for manufacturing buyers
* Build and maintain sales enablement assets: demo environments, capability decks, objection\-handling guides, and ROI frameworks that equip field teams to position the intelligence layer confidently
* Engage with Marketing on thought leadership, analyst relations, and campaign strategy — ensuring QAD's AI and analytics narrative reflects the depth and differentiation of what the platform can actually deliver
* Work with Solutions Engineering and Pre\-Sales on complex enterprise deals — providing product depth in discovery, RFP responses, and proof\-of\-concept engagements where the intelligence layer is a key differentiator


**Customer Discovery \& UX Partnership**
* Maintain a structured and continuous customer discovery programme — conducting regular interviews, site visits, and advisory sessions with manufacturing customers across segments and geographies
* Translate customer discovery into sharp problem definitions and validated hypotheses before committing roadmap resources — ensuring the team builds what the market needs, not what it assumes
* Serve as a named executive contact for key enterprise customers and design partners; build relationships that provide early access to real workflows, pain points, and adoption barriers
* Partner closely with UX and Design from problem framing through to launch — ensuring the intelligence layer is not just technically capable but genuinely usable by non\-technical manufacturing users
* Champion the user in internal prioritisation debates; bring customer evidence — not opinion — to roadmap and trade\-off discussions


**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and grow a team of PMs and TPOs; create a high\-performance, execution\-focused product culture with strong discovery and delivery discipline
* Drive alignment across Product, Engineering, UX, Customer Success, Sales, and Executive leadership on platform priorities and sequencing
* Represent the Data, AI \& Analytics platform in senior leadership forums, including roadmap reviews with the President's office


**Qualifications**
**Experience**
* 15\+ years in product management, with significant time in data platforms, analytics, or AI/ML products in enterprise SaaS environments
* Proven track record owning 0\-to\-1 and scale\-up AI Insights or analytics platforms — from early access through enterprise GA
* Experience in ERP, CRM, or broader B2B enterprise software; deep familiarity with the data needs of complex enterprise operations
* Demonstrated ability to drive measurable outcomes: user growth, CSAT improvement, cost optimization, and revenue expansion through platform capabilities
* Prior experience working directly with Sales, Pre\-Sales, and Marketing to build GTM motions and enablement for platform or data products — not just handing off a roadmap but actively participating in market positioning and deals
* History of structured customer discovery practice — conducting interviews, running advisory boards, or embedding with customers to build evidence\-based roadmaps


**Technical Depth**
* Hands\-on fluency with: LLM evaluation frameworks, semantic layer design, knowledge graphs, RAG architectures, conversational analytics, and agentic AI
* Strong command of data platform architecture: Snowflake, Databricks, delta sharing, ETL/ELT, event\-driven pipelines, federated search
* Ability to engage deeply with engineering on infrastructure trade\-offs — pipeline cost, performance at scale, and AI feature architecture
* Working knowledge of SQL, data modelling, and API design sufficient to hold authoritative technical conversations


**Leadership \& Communication**
* Director\-level leadership maturity: translates business strategy into functional plans, reconciles multi\-stakeholder views, and drives execution across matrixed organizations
* Comfortable operating on complex, ambiguous problems where established frameworks don't apply — defines the approach, not just follows one
* Makes decisions with long\-horizon awareness; understands that platform architecture choices compound over years and plans accordingly
* Proven experience building and scaling product teams; consistent track record of developing strong PMs and fostering a culture of ownership
* Excellent executive communication — makes complex platform decisions accessible to non\-technical senior leaders and enterprise customers alike
* Actively engages with major customers and cross\-functional leaders; able to negotiate priorities and build consensus across competing stakeholder views
* Strong collaborator with UX and Design — understands that intelligence platform adoption lives or dies on usability, not just capability


**Preferred Background**
* Prior experience at enterprise SaaS companies scaling AI/analytics platforms to multi\-thousand customer deployments
* Familiarity with manufacturing ERP data models, production operations, or supply chain analytics is a strong plus
* Experience defining and owning monetization strategy for data or AI platform features
* Patents, publications, or open\-source contributions in AI, data infrastructure, or analytics are valued


**Why This Role at QAD**
* Direct impact: Your roadmap decisions will shape AI capabilities used by thousands of manufacturers worldwide
* Strategic mandate: This is not a maintenance role — it is a build mandate at the intersection of AI, data, and enterprise ERP
* Executive visibility: You will operate at the centre of QAD's platform transformation, with direct access to the President's office and cross\-functional leadership
* Pune platform hub: QAD is actively expanding its platform engineering and product capabilities in India — you will be a founding voice in that growth


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea\-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set


**About QAD**
 QAD \| Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD \| Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
   

  

 QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
   

  

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: Independent Entrepreneur
description:
**Company Description** 
 Self\-entrepreneur is a consulting\-focused venture specializing in product management, product operations, and the organization of digital activities. The initiative supports businesses in structuring and optimizing their digital products and workflows. It emphasizes practical, outcome\-oriented advice to help organizations improve efficiency, customer experience, and growth. The work involves close collaboration with clients to design strategies, processes, and tools that align with their business goals.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Pune/Pimpri\-Chinchwad Area for an Independent Entrepreneur operating under the Self\-entrepreneur brand. The role involves defining and refining product strategies, organizing and overseeing digital operations, and advising clients on best practices in product management and workflow optimization. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include meeting with clients, analyzing their current digital processes, designing improved structures and roadmaps, and coordinating implementation with stakeholders. The Independent Entrepreneur will manage their own business development activities, maintain client relationships, and continuously identify new opportunities for consulting and service offerings. The role requires a high level of autonomy, proactive problem\-solving, and the ability to deliver clear, actionable guidance to diverse organizations.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Demonstrated experience in product management, including roadmap planning, prioritization, and stakeholder alignment.
* Knowledge of product operations and process optimization for digital products or services.
* Ability to design and organize digital workflows, including documentation, communication channels, and delivery practices.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with experience assessing business needs and translating them into structured solutions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for client\-facing consultations and presentations.
* Proven capability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and drive initiatives from concept to execution.
* Prior experience as a consultant, founder, or entrepreneur is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Familiarity with common digital tools for project management, collaboration, and product tracking (e.g., Jira, Trello, Notion, or similar).

title: Senior Implementation Consultant
description:
**Zycus** 
 is looking for an Senior Implementation Consultant with expertise in eProcurement implementation. The ideal candidate will have 6\-10 years of experience in end\-to\-end implementation of procurement software and a strong understanding of Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) or Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) solutions like SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Basware, Jaggaer, or similar platforms.
 



  





 In this role, you will lead complex, global implementations for Fortune 1000 enterprises, driving successful deployment, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. You will also play a key role in enabling AI\-driven procurement transformation, leveraging intelligent automation, analytics, and emerging technologies.
 



  





**Job Overview** 




  





 As a Senior Implementation Consultant, you will own the end\-to\-end implementation lifecycle of our procurement SaaS platform. You will work closely with clients, product teams, and technical stakeholders to deliver scalable, integrated, and intelligent procurement solutions.
 



 You will also contribute to embedding AI capabilities into procurement workflows, enhancing efficiency, decision\-making, and user experience.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Implementation \& Delivery
 



  




* Lead end\-to\-end implementation of procurement SaaS solutions for global clients.
* Gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into scalable solution designs.
* Configure and customize the platform to align with client\-specific procurement processes.
* Drive integration with ERP and third\-party systems using APIs and middleware.
* Manage and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT), ensuring high\-quality deployments.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with high customer satisfaction.



  





 Client Engagement \& Enablement
 



  




* Act as a trusted advisor to clients on procurement transformation and best practices.
* Conduct training sessions, workshops, and enablement programs to drive adoption.
* Provide post\-go\-live support and continuous improvement recommendations.



  





 AI \& Digital Transformation Initiatives
 



  




* Collaborate with product and data teams to implement AI\-powered features such as:
* Intelligent invoice processing and automation
* Predictive spend analytics and insights
* Supplier risk scoring and recommendation engines
* Identify opportunities to embed AI/ML into procurement workflows to improve efficiency and decision\-making.
* Drive adoption of automation, chatbots, and AI assistants within procurement processes.
* Analyze client data to recommend data\-driven optimizations and process improvements.
* Contribute to defining AI use cases, solution design, and value realization frameworks.
* Stay current with advancements in AI, GenAI, and automation within procurement and enterprise SaaS.



  





 Collaboration \& Leadership
 



  




* Work closely with cross\-functional teams including Product, Engineering, and Project Management.
* Mentor junior consultants and contribute to knowledge sharing and best practices.
* Support pre\-sales activities, including solution demos and client workshops, where required.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





 Education
 



  




* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or a related field.



  





 Experience
 



  




* 6–10 years of experience in SaaS implementation, preferably in procurement or supply chain solutions.
* Strong expertise in S2P and P2P processes.
* Hands\-on experience with any one of these platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, Jaggaer, Basware, or similar.
* Proven experience in system configuration, customization, and ERP integrations.
* Exposure to APIs, data integration, and cloud technologies.



  





 Preferred Skills
 


* Experience working with AI/ML\-enabled enterprise applications or automation tools.
* Understanding of data analytics, reporting, and visualization tools.
* Familiarity with Agile/Waterfall project methodologies.
* Strong problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced, global environment.



  





 Location: Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune
 



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work with leading global enterprises to drive digital and AI\-led procurement transformation.
* Be part of a fast\-growing SaaS organization at the forefront of AI innovation in procurement.
* Thrive in a collaborative, high\-impact, and innovation\-driven environment.
* Opportunity to shape next\-generation intelligent procurement solutions.

title: Program Mananger - ERP Implementation
description:
Zycus is seeking a Program Manager – Implementation to lead end\-to\-end enterprise SaaS / ERP implementations for global customers. The ideal candidate will have proven experience managing complex digital transformation programs across ERP, supply chain, procurement, finance, HR tech, CRM, or other enterprise technology platforms.
 



  





 We are specifically seeking professionals with an
 **AI\-first mindset** 
 who embrace innovation, continuously explore emerging technologies, and can effectively integrate AI\-driven approaches into enterprise implementation and transformation programs.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in program governance, stakeholder management, risk management, and change management strategies, particularly for large\-scale global rollouts and enterprise transformation initiatives.
 



  





 We are looking for AI\-first and innovation\-driven professionals who are passionate about leveraging Artificial Intelligence, automation, analytics, and emerging technologies to transform enterprise implementation and delivery experiences. The candidate should demonstrate adaptability toward AI\-enabled ways of working and possess a continuous learning mindset in the evolving enterprise technology landscape.
 



  





 Role \& Responsibilities
 



  




* Lead and oversee end\-to\-end implementation programs for Zycus enterprise SaaS solutions across global customers.
* Drive successful execution of multiple enterprise implementation projects across diverse industry verticals and geographical regions.
* Conduct project kick\-off meetings to establish objectives, scope, deliverables, governance structure, and customer expectations.
* Track project progress and ensure timely delivery by managing scope, timelines, cost, quality, dependencies, and change requests.
* Draft, review, and obtain sign\-off on Statements of Work (SOW), project plans, and implementation deliverables.
* Lead governance cadences including weekly status reviews, steering committee meetings, escalation discussions, and stakeholder updates.

* Ensure efficient resource planning and cross\-functional collaboration for successful project delivery.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives within Professional Services by implementing best practices, delivery excellence frameworks, and operational optimization programs.
* Drive AI\-first implementation and delivery practices by leveraging intelligent automation, analytics, AI copilots, and modern collaboration tools to improve customer outcomes, operational efficiency, and project governance.
* Partner with internal product, delivery, and innovation teams to identify opportunities for AI\-led process optimization and implementation acceleration.
* Promote a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement by encouraging adoption of AI\-powered tools, automation frameworks, and data\-driven decision\-making practices.
* Leverage AI\-enabled project management approaches for risk identification, status reporting, resource optimization, and delivery insights.
* Foster a collaborative and innovation\-driven culture by enabling brainstorming sessions and encouraging new ideas and process improvements.
* Travel periodically to customer locations for project discussions, workshops, requirements gathering, executive reviews, and implementation planning.
* Mentor and guide project teams through regular coaching, one\-on\-one discussions, and delivery reviews to ensure high performance and continuous learning.



  





 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 



  




* 10–15 years of proven experience in program management and enterprise project delivery within SaaS, cloud, ERP, or digital transformation environments.
* Strong experience managing end\-to\-end implementations for enterprise/global customers.
* Experience with enterprise platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, Ariba, Coupa, Ivalua, GEP, JAGGAER, JD Edwards, or similar enterprise SaaS/ERP applications.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies, governance models, implementation frameworks, and delivery best practices.
* Proven expertise in risk management, escalation management, and change management for enterprise transformation programs.
* Strong AI\-first mindset with curiosity and adaptability toward emerging technologies, intelligent automation, generative AI, AI copilots, and modern digital transformation practices.
* Experience using AI\-powered productivity, collaboration, analytics, or project management tools to improve delivery effectiveness and operational efficiency.
* Demonstrated ability to drive innovation and process transformation using automation and AI\-enabled approaches within enterprise delivery environments.
* Awareness of evolving enterprise AI trends and their impact on SaaS implementation, customer success, and digital transformation programs.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple complex projects in a fast\-paced global environment.
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams and international customers.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* PMP, Agile, PRINCE2, Scrum, or similar certifications will be preferred.



  





 Preferred Experience
 



  




* Experience in procurement, supply chain, finance, HR tech, CRM, ITSM, or other enterprise transformation domains will be considered an advantage, but is not mandatory.
* Experience working in SaaS product organizations or enterprise cloud transformation programs is highly preferred.
* Candidates demonstrating proactive adoption of AI tools, automation\-led thinking, digital innovation initiatives, or AI\-enabled delivery practices will be strongly preferred.
* Exposure to AI\-led transformation initiatives, intelligent automation, or digital innovation programs will be a strong advantage.



  





**Location: Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune** 




  





 Why You Should Join Zycus?
 



  





**Work with leading global enterprises to drive digital and AI\-led procurement transformation.** 



* Be part of a fast\-growing SaaS organization at the forefront of AI innovation in procurement.
* Thrive in a collaborative, high\-impact, and innovation\-driven environment.
* Opportunity to shape next\-generation intelligent procurement solutions.

title: HRMS Functional Consultant
description:
NuVista Technologies is looking for an experienced HRMS Functional Consultant to support the implementation, configuration, and enhancement of NuSmart HRMS. The consultant should possess strong HR domain knowledge, experience implementing HRMS solutions, and a working understanding of Oracle NetSuite.
 



 The role involves working closely with customers, HR teams, technical consultants, and project managers to translate business requirements into effective HRMS solutions.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Conduct discovery workshops to understand customers’ HR policies, processes, organisational structures, and reporting requirements.
* Analyse existing HR processes and recommend suitable configurations and process improvements using NuSmart HRMS.
* Configure and implement HRMS modules, including:
* Employee master data
* Organisation structure
* Recruitment and applicant tracking
* Employee onboarding and offboarding
* Leave and attendance management
* Timesheets
* Payroll inputs and processing workflows
* Performance management
* Learning and development
* Employee self\-service and manager self\-service
* HR reports, dashboards, and approvals
* Prepare business requirement documents, functional specifications, process\-flow diagrams, configuration documents, and user manuals.
* Map customer requirements to NuSmart HRMS capabilities and identify configuration, customisation, and integration requirements.
* Work with NetSuite functional and technical teams to integrate HRMS processes with finance, payroll, projects, expense management, and other business functions.
* Understand NetSuite records, roles, permissions, workflows, saved searches, reports, dashboards, and integration concepts.
* Support data collection, cleansing, validation, migration, and reconciliation activities.
* Coordinate with technical consultants and developers for customisations, integrations, reports, and workflow development.
* Prepare and execute functional test cases, system integration testing, and user acceptance testing.
* Conduct product demonstrations, customer training, and knowledge\-transfer sessions.
* Provide post\-implementation support, troubleshoot functional issues, and recommend system enhancements.
* Manage customer expectations, document action items, and ensure timely completion of project deliverables.
* Support pre\-sales activities, including product demonstrations, requirement discussions, solution preparation, and effort estimation.
* Stay updated on HR technology trends, statutory requirements, HR best practices, and Oracle NetSuite capabilities.


 Required Qualifications and Experience
 * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3–8 years of experience as an HRMS/HCM Functional Consultant, Business Analyst, or HR technology professional.
* Hands\-on experience implementing or supporting HRMS, HCM, payroll, or employee\-management applications.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end HR processes and HR best practices.
* Working knowledge of Oracle NetSuite and its functional architecture.
* Experience in requirements gathering, process mapping, solution configuration, testing, training, and post\-go\-live support.
* Ability to translate HR requirements into clear functional and technical specifications.
* Good understanding of integrations, APIs, data migration, workflows, roles, permissions, and reporting.
* Strong analytical, documentation, problem\-solving, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate with customers, developers, project managers, and cross\-functional teams.


 Preferred Qualifications
 * Experience with NetSuite SuitePeople or other NetSuite\-based HRMS applications.
* Understanding of payroll, statutory compliance, leave, attendance, and employee lifecycle processes.
* Experience implementing cloud\-based SaaS or ERP solutions.
* Knowledge of NetSuite saved searches, SuiteFlow workflows, dashboards, and reports.
* Experience working with customers across India or international markets.
* Relevant certifications in NetSuite, HRMS, HCM, payroll, or business analysis would be an advantage.


 Key Competencies
 * HR domain and process knowledge
* Functional consulting and solution design
* Customer communication and workshop facilitation
* Business analysis and documentation
* HRMS configuration and testing
* NetSuite functional knowledge
* Data migration and validation
* Training and change management
* Problem\-solving and attention to detail
* Project coordination and ownership

title: Sr Product Manager EDR
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
   

  

**The Role**
 Aspen Technology, a business unit inside Emerson Corporation, is a leading industrial software company, serving over 3,000 customers with over $1 billion in annual revenue, more than 60 locations worldwide, and nearly 4,000 employees. AspenTech solutions address complex environments where it is critical to optimize the asset design, operation and maintenance lifecycle.
   

  

 Through AspenTech’s unique combination of deep domain expertise and award\-winning innovative software suites, customers in asset\-intensive industries can improve their operational excellence while achieving sustainability goals.
   

  

 The AspenTech Performance Engineering Solution provides a market leading integrated suite of products to optimize the performance of process industry assets across the CAPEX and OPEX cycles and is powered by flagship process modeling products with a proven track record of value creation over several decades.
   

  

 Aspen Exchanger Design \& Rating (EDR) is a comprehensive heat exchanger modeling and design suite that helps process engineers and equipment manufacturers optimize thermal equipment performance across the asset lifecycle. It delivers customer value through improved engineering productivity, reduced project risk, and lower CAPEX/OPEX via accurate, integrated equipment design and analysis.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 We are seeking an experienced and highly analytical Product Manager to lead the strategy and evolution of our Aspen Exchanger Design and Rating (EDR). In this role, you will define the roadmap for industry\-leading equipment design software used by process engineers and equipment manufacturers globally. You will work at the intersection of complex thermodynamic modeling and modern software development, ensuring our heat exchanger and equipment design solutions integrate seamlessly with broader process simulation workflows (such as Aspen Plus and Aspen HYSYS) while delivering exceptional user experience.
   

  

**Product Vision, Strategy, and Sharp Execution**
* Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for the product, backed by financial assessment such as a business case
* Responsible for Agile roadmap for the product lifecycle (ideation and formation through execution), specifying the positioning, pricing, differentiation, competitive strategy, and definable value and proof points
* Aligns the product vision and strategy to overall Performance Engineering and AspenTech objectives
* Monitor industry trends, competitive developments, and customer requirements.


**Customer Engagement and Customer Centricity**
* Build strong relationships with key customers, industry leaders, and strategic partners.
* Serve as a thought leader and advocate for AspenTech process simulation solutions internally and externally
* Champion customer\-centric product development, balancing market needs, innovation and business objectives.


**Portfolio Ownership and Growth Focus**
* Drive business growth through increased customer adoption, expansion into new markets, and successful introduction of new capabilities.
* Drive innovation initiatives that strengthen competitive differentiation and market leadership, with close collaboration with R\&D and other teams such as AI, UX and other product portfolios
* Support evaluation of potential technology acquisitions and strategic partnerships that can accelerate market growth and product differentiation.
* Partner closely with Product Marketing, Sales, Services, Solution Consulting to drive growth
* Partner with thermal, chemical, and mechanical engineering domain experts to translate complex heat transfer and fluid flow calculation requirements into actionable software features
* Facilitate cross\-functional collaboration and successful outcomes.


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. MBA a plus.
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise software Product Management, ideally within engineering, simulation, or industrial software domains.
* Strong foundational understanding of process engineering, heat transfer, thermodynamics, or equipment design.
* Experience developing product strategies, business cases, and growth plans for enterprise software products

* Proven ability to design and manage enterprise data integrations, leveraging APIs, SQL, and data analysis techniques to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and timely availability across planning ecosystems.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and troubleshooting skills with expertise in reporting, analytics, controls, access management, documentation, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial modeling, complemented by experience working within Agile delivery frameworks and modern Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices.

* Establish clear ways of working across backlog management, sprint execution, release planning, quality reviews, documentation, and production support.
* Coach team members on Anaplan best practices, model design, data management, performance optimization, and business engagement.
* Create a sustainable capability model with role clarity, cross\-training, succession planning, and measurable skill maturity.
* Strategy, Roadmap \& Stakeholder Management
* Partner with Finance, FP\&A, HR, Risk, Corporate Functions, and Technology stakeholders to define priorities, business outcomes, and delivery roadmap.
* Translate business needs into scalable Anaplan solutions that improve forecasting, workforce planning, scenario analysis, expense planning, and management reporting.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders by providing clear options, risks, dependencies, trade\-offs, and recommendations.
* Lead prioritization forums and drive alignment across business value, regulatory needs, capacity, and technical feasibility.
* Solution Architecture \& Delivery Ownership
* Own end\-to\-end design and delivery of enterprise Anaplan capabilities across Staff Planning, Forecasting, CCAR, Income Statement planning, cost center planning, and scenario modeling.
* Design scalable multi\-model architectures using Data Hub, ALM, controlled data flows, modular design principles, and reusable planning components.
* Ensure models are performant, auditable, maintainable, secure, and aligned to Anaplan and enterprise technology standards.
* Oversee requirements, design, build, testing, UAT, deployment, documentation, and post\-production stabilization.
* Platform Operations, Controls \& Data Quality
* Strengthen production support, incident management, release governance, access controls, and operational risk management.
* Establish data validation, reconciliation, completeness checks, and error\-handling processes across inbound and outbound planning data.
* Drive improvements in platform stability, data accuracy, business adoption, user experience, and planning cycle efficiency.
* Maintain strong documentation for model architecture, data lineage, integrations, controls, release records, and support procedures.


  

  

* Innovation \& Continuous Improvement
* Identify opportunities to simplify planning processes, automate manual activities, enhance reporting visibility, and improve self\-service capability.
* Evaluate and apply modern planning practices including predictive planning, advanced analytics, AI\-enabled insights, and integration automation where appropriate.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement, operational precision, accountability, and business\-value driven delivery.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems
* 10\+ years of experience in enterprise planning, financial systems, EPM platforms, FP\&A technology, or related finance technology domains.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on Anaplan implementation, model building, and solution architecture experience.
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-scale planning implementations from concept through production deployment.
* Strong working knowledge of FP\&A, forecasting, budgeting, workforce planning, management reporting, cost center planning, and financial data structures.
* Anaplan Certified Solution Architect or Master Anaplanner credentials preferred.
* Experience with Hyperion, Oracle EPM, OneStream, SAP BPC, Workday, Power BI, SQL, ETL tools, APIs, or enterprise data platforms is good to have
* Experience in banking, financial services, regulatory planning, risk, CCAR, SOX\-controlled environments, or large global enterprises.
* Strong Agile delivery experience and familiarity with SDLC, DevOps, change management, and release governance.
* Experience designing Data Hub architecture, integrations, validation routines, and controlled data flows.
* Demonstrated experience building, mentoring, and leading technical teams.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and problem\-solving skills.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
🚀 We’re Hiring: Senior Product Manager – Mealawe
 



 📍 Pune
 



 💼 Experience: 5–9 Years
 



 💰 CTC: ₹25–35 LPA \+ Attractive ESOPs
 



  





 Mealawe is looking for a Senior Product Manager who can own a consumer product end\-to\-end — from customer insights and competitive analysis to product experience, pricing, P\&L, conversion, retention and growth.
 



 This is not a coordination\-only Product Manager role. We are looking for someone who has already independently owned a consumer\-facing product or business line and is comfortable taking decisions that directly impact customers, revenue, profitability and growth.
 



  





 What You Will Own
 



  





 • End\-to\-end ownership of Mealawe’s customer\-facing digital product
 



 • Product strategy, roadmap and continuous product improvement
 



 • Product P\&L, revenue, margins and unit economics
 



 • Pricing, offers, subscriptions and promotional strategy
 



 • Competitive analysis and market benchmarking
 



 • Customer research, feedback and behavioural analysis
 



 • Improving the complete customer purchase journey across mobile and web
 



 • Product discovery, selection, cart, checkout, payment, repeat purchase and retention
 



 • Identifying customer drop\-offs across the purchase funnel and driving improvements
 



 • Conversion, AOV, repeat rate, retention and customer experience
 



 • Working closely with UI/UX and Design teams to build simple, intuitive and high\-converting customer journeys
 



 • Coordinating closely with Performance Marketing and Growth teams on CAC, ROAS, conversion quality, customer cohorts and funnel performance
 



 • Translating campaign and customer data into product improvements
 



 • Working with Technology teams from problem identification through design, development, launch and post\-launch measurement
 



 • A/B testing across user journeys, pricing, offers, communication, landing pages and checkout flows
 



 • Analysing performance across cities, products, customer segments and acquisition channels
 



 • Identifying underperforming areas of the product and driving corrective action
 



 • Building dashboards and review mechanisms for faster decision\-making
 



 • Presenting product performance, customer insights, problems and action plans directly to senior leadership
 



  





 We Are Specifically Looking For
 



  





 ✅ 5–9 years of total professional experience
 



 ✅ Minimum 5 years of relevant Product Management / Consumer Product / Business Product experience
 



 ✅ At least 1 year of independent ownership of a product or business line
 



 ✅ B2C or D2C experience is mandatory
 



 ✅ Hands\-on experience managing a customer\-facing mobile app or web product where users discover, select and purchase products or services online
 



 ✅ Strong understanding of the complete consumer transaction funnel:
 



 Traffic → Landing → Discovery → Selection → Cart → Checkout → Payment → Repeat → Retention
 



 ✅ Candidates currently working in B2C/D2C will be strongly preferred
 



 ✅ Previous B2B experience is acceptable if your current/recent experience is strongly B2C/D2C focused
 



 ✅ Minimum 2–3 years in a startup, scale\-up or high\-velocity organisation
 



 ✅ Strong experience with P\&L, unit economics and profitability
 



 ✅ Hands\-on understanding of pricing, competition, customer behaviour and commercial metrics
 



 ✅ Experience working closely with Performance Marketing / Growth teams
 



 ✅ Experience collaborating with UI/UX, Product Design and Technology teams
 



 ✅ Strong data\-driven decision\-making ability
 



  





 Relevant Backgrounds
 



  





 We would particularly like to meet candidates from:
 



 Consumer Internet \| Food\-Tech \| Quick Commerce \| E\-commerce \| Marketplaces \| D2C \| Subscription Businesses \| Consumer Apps
 



  





 Experience in a high\-frequency transactional product — where customers regularly browse, purchase, pay and return — will be highly relevant.
 



  





 What Will Make You Stand Out
 



  





 You should be able to demonstrate measurable examples where you have:
 



 • Improved revenue or contribution margin
 



 • Improved conversion or retention
 



 • Built or scaled a consumer digital product
 



 • Improved product discovery, cart, checkout or payment journeys
 



 • Changed pricing or offers based on data
 



 • Reduced customer drop\-offs in the purchase funnel
 



 • Improved repeat purchase or subscription behaviour
 



 • Identified competitive gaps and acted on them
 



 • Worked with Performance Marketing to improve acquisition quality or conversion
 



 • Worked with UI/UX teams to materially improve customer experience
 



 • Built and measured successful product experiments
 



 • Turned around an underperforming consumer product or funnel
 



  





 What Success Looks Like
 



  





 You should be able to answer questions such as:
 



 Why are customers dropping between landing and purchase?
 



 Which part of the app or web journey needs improvement?
 



 What are competitors doing better?
 



 Are we priced correctly?
 



 Which offers are actually improving incremental revenue?
 



 Why are some marketing campaigns bringing better customers than others?
 



 How can we improve conversion without destroying margins?
 



 How can we increase repeat purchase and retention?
 



 What should UI/UX, Technology and Performance Marketing teams work on next — and why?
 



 You will be expected to move from:
 



 Data → Insight → Decision → Execution → Measurement
 



  





 What We Offer
 



  





 💰 ₹25–35 LPA
 



 📈 Attractive ESOPs
 



 🎯 Significant product ownership and decision\-making responsibility
 



 🚀 Opportunity to directly influence product, customer experience, growth and business economics
 



 🤝 Direct exposure to senior leadership and high\-impact business decisions
 



  





 If you enjoy working at the intersection of Product \+ Consumer Behaviour \+ P\&L \+ Growth \+ Performance Marketing \+ UI/UX \+ Technology, we would like to hear from you.
 



 Apply through LinkedIn or share your profile with us.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Zendesk builds AI powered, customizable and simple to use service software crafted to improve customer relationships. Many of the world’s favorite brands leverage our products to engage you as a customer. We lead the industry with beautifully simple software, and you’ve almost certainly interacted with it without knowing it!**
**We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our Strategic Integrations and Connections capabilities which are used to connect, sync, and orchestrate across Zendesk and other systems.**
**In this role will have significant direct interaction with customers, partners, and executive sponsors. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams; engineering, design, product marketing, sales, and tech alliances to build and launch solutions. This position is well suited to an individual who has experience building partnerships to launch joint solutions. You are excellent at building relationships with stakeholders both inside and outside the org chart. Success in this role will be driven by your ability to balance priorities, manage expectations, rapidly execute on initiatives that meet customer needs, operate across many geographical distributed stakeholders, and work productively with external partners.**
****As a Senior Product Manager for Strategic Integrations and Connections you’ll…****
* Be capable of working without direction or regular oversight. You’re already experienced in the discipline of product management and comfortable leading product delivery teams, making decisions, and reporting back to leadership. You know what needs to be done and you’re independent and self\-driven enough to do it.
* Be a subject matter expert in your product area, and work with customers to further understand their needs and develop that expertise
* Be a strategic leader for this area, setting and articulating a vision and roadmap on which integrations to invest and divest.
* Work with Tech Alliances and partners to identify opportunities to grow partnerships and build solutions that create co\-marketing moments and solve joint\-customer’s problems
* Drive the direction of new capabilities and enhancements with engineering and design partners, ensuring that solutions built adequately capture the opportunity and solve the customer need. You don’t own the delivery, but you drive it.
* Where necessary, interact with executives to respond to customer escalations. Attend customer meetings with those executives and de\-escalate situations through your calm and controlled demeanor, bringing a plan to resolve issues and build trust and confidence with customers and executives.
* Possess exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to, champion and shape organizational decisions using your words and influence.
* Define OKRs, success metrics and review performance against those.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree, with 5 years of Product Management experience under your belt, delivering products that met business goals.
* Your work experience will include customer\-focused SaaS, designing and shipping “full\-stack” from front\-end, to back\-end, and APIs.
* A great collaborator that knows that to deliver anything of value is a team effort and likes to dig in with intelligent and passionate engineers to find the best solution to a problem.
* Ability to understand complex systems, and balance appropriate tradeoffs between performance, cost, and user experience.
* A self\-starter with a bias for action who is motivated to solve problems and deliver results with an owner mentality.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for varying audiences: customers, engineering, marketing, program management, and executives.
* The drive to deeply understand our product, the market, our customers, and when to use the right data to measure success, using analytics tools to aid in decision\-making.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* The SCRUM team in this role is based in Melbourne and Pune, so experience product managing a geographically distributed engineering team will be helpful.


 Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.
   

  

 Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration \- while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in\-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.
   

  

**The Intelligent Heart Of Customer Experience**
 Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.
   

  

 Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.

title: Release Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
* End\-to\-End Ownership and Accountability \- Take full ownership of the release and program lifecycle – including product definition, prototyping, development, continuous integration, testing, production release and post\-release evaluation\-managing scope, schedule, cost and quality from product definition to product release
* Strategic Planning and Execution – Develop and execute strategic forecasts and plans, set clear milestones to keep the releases and programs on track
* Leadership and Cross\-Functional Collaboration – Provide leadership to multi\-functional and cross\-functional teams, aligning stakeholders and influencing teams without direct authority to achieve shared goals.
* Customer\-Centric Product Delivery – Partner product management, and engineering teams to ensure solutions and releases address customer needs.
* Risk Management and Problem Solving – Proactively identify, assess, prioritize, and mitigate program risks that may impact delivery commitments.
* Quality, Productivity, and Continuous Improvement – Ensure every release and program meets the highest standards of quality, productivity, efficiency and reliability. Drive initiatives, continuous and measurable improvements ensuring each release and program is better than the last.
* Communication and Stakeholder Engagement – Communicate clear, actionable regular updates to stakeholders and all levels of the organization on details of release/programs, progress, risks and resolutions.
* Compliance and Standards – Ensure compliance with corporate, environmental and legislative requirements, safety and cybersecurity.
* Post Release/Program Evaluation – Lead post release/program evaluations to identify success and areas for improvement.


**Who You Are:**
 You thrive in high\-pressure, high\-visibility environments and are comfortable navigating ambiguity. You collaborate effectively across diverse teams, building alignment and driving programs from concept through successful delivery. By actively listening, seeking diverse perspectives, and fostering open communication, you enable informed decision\-making and shared commitment to outcomes. You are passionate about delivering innovative products and orchestrating complex launches, taking initiative to achieve meaningful business impact.
   

  

**For This Role, You Will Need:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in computer engineering or any other engineering field with 10\-12 years of project management experience in an embedded product development.
* PMP certified professional and Scrum Master certification would be an added advantage.
* Working experience in leading complex product development programs in a global setup.
* Hands\-on experience in Electronics Hardware/Embedded Software development would be useful.
* Project management experience in embedded product development is a must for this role.
* To have demonstrated ability to plan/manage budget, resources, work activities, and risks/mitigations working on New Product Development (NPD) projects.
* Organizational, problem solving and interpersonal skills with cross cultural adaptation.
* To have demonstrated time management and multi\-tasking abilities.

description:
**Job Summary**
 This hybrid role for an experienced product consultant focuses on designing enhancing and supporting manufacturing execution and billing solutions using C sharp Angular JS SQL scripting and Critical Manufacturing MES. * Drive detailed requirement discovery sessions with business stakeholders in customer billing and invoice adjustment domains to translate complex operational needs into clear product features and technical specifications within Critical Manufacturing MES.

* Develop high quality software components using C sharp and Angular JS that support intuitive user interfaces and reliable backend services enabling efficient management of customer billing events and adjustment authorizations.
* Create optimized SQL scripts and database procedures that ensure data integrity performance and traceability for transactions related to customer invoices adjustments and billing authorizations within enterprise systems.
* Collaborate closely with cross functional teams including business analysts architects and operations specialists to prioritize product backlog items that deliver measurable impact on revenue assurance and manufacturing efficiency.
* Provide expert guidance on the use of Critical Manufacturing MES capabilities such as production modeling data collection and integration interfaces to enhance visibility across the authorise customer billing and invoice adjustment lifecycle.
* Conduct rigorous testing validation and defect resolution activities for MES and billing related solutions ensuring that product enhancements meet quality standards regulatory requirements and organizational performance targets.
* Mentor junior consultants and technical team members in best practices for product configuration coding standards and solution troubleshooting to build a strong delivery culture and sustain operational excellence.
* Prepare detailed functional and technical documentation for MES configurations application components and SQL scripts so that support teams can maintain and evolve solutions with minimal disruption to business operations.
* Engage in continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing system usage metrics billing accuracy trends and production performance indicators to propose product changes that enhance customer satisfaction and societal value through efficient manufacturing.
* Support stakeholders during go live and post implementation phases by resolving complex incidents performing root cause analysis and recommending preventive actions that stabilize billing and manufacturing execution processes.
* Coordinate with security and compliance teams to ensure that MES and billing solutions adhere to organizational policies data protection standards and audit requirements while maintaining usability and process efficiency.


**Qualifications**
* Bring nine to twelve years of progressive experience in product consulting or solution implementation with a focus on complex manufacturing and billing environments supported by large scale enterprise systems.
* Demonstrate strong hands on proficiency in C sharp including object oriented design patterns integration techniques and performance tuning practices relevant for production grade applications.
* Exhibit advanced capability in Angular JS for building responsive secure and maintainable front end interfaces that enable efficient execution of manufacturing and billing tasks by diverse user groups.
* Apply deep knowledge of SQL scripting and relational database concepts to design queries procedures and optimization strategies that support high volume transaction processing and analytical reporting.
* Show proven experience working with Critical Manufacturing MES including configuration integration and customization to align production workflows with customer billing and invoice adjustment requirements.
* Display solid understanding of authorize customer billing and invoice adjustment domain processes including validation controls exception handling and reconciliation practices across enterprise operations.
* Operate effectively in hybrid work settings demonstrating strong communication collaboration and documentation skills that ensure smooth coordination across onsite and remote stakeholders.

title: Senior MDM Service Delivery Manager
description:

 At Smith\+Nephew, we design and manufacture technology that takes the limits off living.

If you're eager to be part of a vibrant environment that fosters growth and collaboration, look no further. Explore our latest job opening for Senior Service Delivery Manager (SDM) for MDM who is responsible for end\-to\-end service delivery, operations and continuous improvement of Master Data Management (MDM). The SDM owns the service lifecycle from Inception to Build through Run. This role ensures platform stability, data integrity and data quality while driving governance, vendor management, and roadmap execution.
   

  

**What will you be doing?**
* Your will contribute, and Lead and handle the full lifecycle of MDM projects, ensuring successful delivery within scope, schedule, and budget across global regions.
* Role serves as the primary interface between business stakeholders, data governance, IT, and external partners to ensure the MDM platform supports business growth, digital transformation, and data\-driven decision\-making. This role is also expected to prepare for our strategic ERP transition to SAP S/4HANA.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines, resource allocations, and risk management strategies, to drive project execution and achieve project objectives across geographically dispersed teams.
* Collaborate with multi\-functional teams to define requirements and design solutions that meet global business needs and improve data management capabilities, with a focus on simplifying sophisticated processes and articulate design of data architecture that is balanced and scalable.
* Provide leadership and mentorship to globally dispersed teams, encouraging a collaborative and high\-performance work environment that promotes effective communication and detailed coordination.
* Ensure compliance with Sarbanes\-Oxley (SOX) regulations, effective IT General Controls and GXP validation requirements are met. Improve customer matching processes and accuracy in collaboration with functional teams. Improve data availability for Tenders Management with speed and accuracy.
* Collaborate closely with Business and Functional area leadership to improve the quality and value of core data assets. Act as main point of contact for collaborators, leading communication and expectations globally and ensuring aligned global project goals and priorities.
* Conduct regular project status meetings with teams, prepare progress reports, and facilitate cross\-regional collaboration to ensure transparency and alignment with global project objectives. Work closely with MDM team to influence decisions for new technologies.
* Influence the sustaining operating model for data governance within the organization by serving as a key doer in defining roles and responsibilities for business as data stewards, Global Business Services (GBS) as data custodians, and IT as systems and technical services, ensuring effective collaboration and alignment in handling and governing master data.


**What will you need to be successful?**
* Education: Bachelor's or equivalent experience or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field.
* Experience: 10\+ years in data platforms, MDM, or enterprise applications. 5\+ years in a service delivery, platform owner, or product owner role.
* Good understanding of MDM concepts, data models, data architecture, data privacy, GDSN, UDP, and standard processes globally.
* Keen understanding of IT Internal Controls and ability to comprehend and respond to internal and external auditors. Knowledge of data governance practices, regulatory requirements, and emerging trends.
* Experience with MDM tools (Win\-shuttle, Syndigo, Informatica MDM) or equivalent platforms, and familiarity with global implementation challenges.
* Excellent leadership and customer management skills with the ability to influence key decision\-makers in a global context.
* Familiarity with agile project management methodologies, with experience in adapting these methodologies to accommodate the needs of global project teams.
* Familiarity with external data sets; such as, IQVIA One Key, GPO rosters, etc.
* Proficient in customer matching process, Customer \& Product hierarchies, and data reconciliation.

description:
**Position Overview**
 Are you looking for a high\-impact career move that places you at the heart of global securities market infrastructure? Bring your expertise in technology strategy, portfolio governance, and investment planning to
 **Citi’s Global Custody Team** 
 .
   

  

 By joining Citi, you will become an integral part of a global organization whose mission is to serve as a trusted partner to institutional clients by responsibly providing financial and custody services that enable growth, operational resilience, and market connectivity
   

  

**Team \& Role Overview**
 The
 **Investment Planning and Portfolio Oversight** 
 role sits within the Custody Business Execution team, and as part of the broader Investor Services business in Citi.
   

  

 This role is responsible for managing the technology budgeting process for the Custody business and overseeing the execution of the change book of work.
   

  

 It covers the full scope of the Custody Product set – Transaction Management, Asset Servicing, FX, Cash, Digital Assets, Tax and Business Services
   

  

 Custody sits within
 **Investor Services** 
 , part of
 **Services** 
 —one of the primary core business lines at Citi. Serving institutional clients across more than 95 markets and operating the industry’s largest proprietary custody network in over 60 markets, Services provides integrated payments and collections, liquidity management, trade services, securities custody, fund administration, and issuer solutions to sovereign wealth funds, asset managers, banks, broker\-dealers, and multinational corporations worldwide.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As the Custody Investment Planning and Portfolio Oversight Lead, you will drive the end\-to\-end global technology investment portfolio for Custody. You will serve as the primary liaison between Custody Product, Operations, Technology, Finance and Investor Services to ensure that multi\-million\-dollar technology investments deliver strategic differentiation, regulatory compliance, risk mitigation, an improved client experience and strong commercial ROI.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Lead Annual Technology Investment Planning: Drive the annual and multi\-year technology book of work (BoW) planning cycle for Custody, establishing and managing a transparent and rigorous investment prioritization framework.
* ROI Tracking \& Portfolio Governance: Implement structured governance forums, scorecard metrics, and financial oversight to track project delivery against budget, monitor capitalization vs. expense burn, and measure post\-implementation commercial/productivity ROI.
* Business Case Formulation \& Appraisal: Partner with Custody Product Managers and Operations Leads to build robust, quantitative business cases and benefits\-realization plans for platform modernization, process automation, digital assets capabilities, and market infrastructure mandates
* Strategic Prioritization \& Risk Reduction: Balance discretionary investments against mandatory/regulatory programs, prioritizing initiatives that optimize asset safety, mitigate operational and counterparty risks, and improve straight\-through processing (STP) rates.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the trusted advisor and central point of coordination for senior business heads across Custody Product, Technology leads, Finance, Operations and the Investor Services team.
* Own the Custody Strategic Investment Story: Help craft the Custody investment thesis, and ensure it propagates through to the execution book of work – top down strategy alignment with bottoms up tech spend.


**What We’ll Need From You**
**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in Financial Services, Securities Services/Custody, or Management Consulting with a focus on Technology Strategy, Investment Portfolio Governance, or Transformation Execution.
* Custody Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Investor Services business – including Global Custody, Direct Custody and post\-trade settlement cycles.
* Portfolio \& Financial Governance: Demonstrated track record in managing large\-scale technology investment budgets, business case evaluations, cost\-benefit analyses, and Capex allocation models.
* Transformation \& Architecture Methodologies: Experience with business capability modeling, target state architecture design, and process mapping frameworks. Agile experience preferable.
* Executive Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication, storytelling, and consensus\-building skills with proven ability to influence senior C\-suite and managing director\-level stakeholders across Product, Technology, and Operations in a matrixed environment.
* Agility \& Analytical Rigour: Strong problem\-solving abilities with experience managing competing priorities under tight delivery and regulatory deadlines.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience.
* Digital and AI native: Embrace new and improved ways of working, putting AI\-capabilities at the centre of a process improvement agenda


**What We Can Offer You**
* High visibility and leadership exposure across Citi's flagship Custody franchise.
* Direct involvement in shaping the multi\-year technology roadmap for a market\-leading securities services provider.
* Broad exposure to cross\-functional initiatives across Investor Services, Markets, and enterprise CTO domains.
* Professional development and continuous learning opportunities within a tier\-1 global institution.

Centered on data\-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments\-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation (Test \& Learn), and data\-driven information and risk management services.
   

  

 As a member of the Business Experimentation Product Management team, you will build industry\-leading experimentation software which brings sophisticated analytic techniques to businesses and users around the world.  Role

**All About You**
 Can work closely with cross\-functional partners like engineers, designers, sales, marketing, and users.
   

  

 A quick learner with the ability to multi\-task in a team environment, not afraid to ask questions and make decisions. Enthusiastic, effective team member and mentor.
   

  

 Broad strategic thinking skills, adept in translating product vision/strategy into an actionable roadmap.
   

  

 Creative problem\-solver, can balance competing needs and prioritize thoughtfully.
   

  

 Strong professional presence. Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.
   

  

 Experience building with AI or using AI to enhance an existing software application
   

  

 5\+ years of professional experience in a similar role, or equivalent.

description:

****Job Description:****
**Job Description:**
 Let me tell you about the role
   

  

 A Product Manager takes ownership of overall product and portfolio success, focusing on understanding customer needs and identifying opportunities to significantly improve its experience. This role involves defining product strategy, crafting a compelling vision, and driving the product lifecycle from concept to launch and scaling. Collaboration is key, working closely with engineers, designers, and business partners to deliver impactful solutions. As a hands\-on contributor, the Product Manager manages day\-to\-day accountability and performance management to achieve product success.
   

  

 What you will deliver
   

  

****Business Focused:****
* Analytical and commercially focused, using data\-driven insights, metrics, and analytics to evaluate product performance and link outcomes to strategy
* Clearly define why we are pushing a product, considering market, competitor, technical, and operational aspects of bp’s strategy and vision
* Understand business and technical economic value, such as TCO, unit economics, NPV, ROIC, and other commercial measures
* Translate vision into strategic product roadmaps with an agile delivery approach in partnership with Tech while handling cyber, operational, and/or regulatory risks
* Plans and control costs associated with running a product, including collecting, analysing, and reporting cost/benefit information to more optimally provide value


****Human Centered:****
* Know and empathize with internal and/or external customer(s) needs to reinvent and innovate product solutions
* Integrate customer and partner feedback loops to ensure that product solutions and outcomes meet organizational needs
* Ability to coach team members and drive cross\-discipline problem solving to achieve business outcomes


****Technology Driven:****

* Collaborate with partners to define end\-state architecture and drive secure, resilient, performant, and scalable technology solutions
* Engage with partners on data management, laying out how data is processed, stored, accessed, and protected
