title: Category Manager - Orthopedic Power Systems
description:
Category Manager \- Orthopedic Power Systems
   

 Location: Pune, Maharashtra
   

 Employment Type: Full\-time
   

 Travel: Extensive domestic travel; occasional international travel
   

  

 1\. Role Purpose
   

  

 The Category Manager – Orthopedic Power Systems will be responsible for building, managing, and growing Manman’s Orthopedic Power Systems business as an independent strategic category.
   

  

 The role will own the complete category lifecycle — from market intelligence, product strategy and portfolio planning to pricing, sales enablement, channel development, marketing, product launches, inventory planning and profitability.
   

  

 The individual will act as the central interface between R\&D, Engineering, Production, Quality \& Regulatory, Sales, Service, Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain, ensuring that the Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio remains clinically relevant, commercially competitive and financially successful.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should combine strong orthopedic product knowledge with commercial and business\-development capability.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 2\. Key Responsibilities
   

  

 A. Category Strategy \& Business Ownership
   

  

 \- Develop and execute the annual and long\-term strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 \- Own category revenue, gross margin, market share and growth objectives.
   

 \- Develop annual business plans covering:
   

 \- Revenue
   

 \- Unit volumes
   

 \- ASP
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- Channel mix
   

 \- Geographic expansion
   

 \- Identify new market opportunities, customer segments and applications for orthopedic power systems.
   

 \- Develop category growth strategies for India and selected international markets.
   

 \- Track competitors, pricing, technology, product launches and market positioning.
   

 \- Identify gaps in Manman’s portfolio and recommend new products or product variants.
   

  

 B. Product Portfolio Management
   

  

 Own the complete Orthopedic Power Systems portfolio, including relevant:
   

  

 \- High\-speed drill systems
   

 \- Large\-bone systems
   

 \- Small\-bone systems
   

 \- Saw systems
   

 \- Oscillating/sagittal saws
   

 \- Reciprocating saws
   

 \- Shaver systems
   

 \- Endoscopic burr systems
   

 \- Attachments
   

 \- Handpieces
   

 \- Accessories
   

 \- Consumables
   

 \- Batteries and chargers
   

 \- Related service and AMC offerings
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Define product positioning and target customer for each product.
   

 \- Maintain the product portfolio and product lifecycle.
   

 \- Identify products requiring upgrades, replacement or discontinuation.
   

 \- Develop product roadmaps in coordination with R\&D and Engineering.
   

 \- Define product specifications based on market and clinical requirements.
   

 \- Gather voice\-of\-customer and surgeon feedback.
   

 \- Convert clinical requirements into clear product requirements for Engineering/R\&D.
   

  

 C. Product Development \& New Product Introduction
   

  

 \- Prepare Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for new products.
   

 \- Work with Engineering/R\&D on product development priorities.
   

 \- Coordinate prototype evaluation with surgeons and key opinion leaders.
   

 \- Organize clinical/user evaluations and product trials.
   

 \- Coordinate with Quality \& Regulatory for required documentation and approvals.
   

 \- Develop launch plans for new products.
   

 \- Establish product readiness gates before commercial launch.
   

 \- Coordinate first production, field trials and commercial release.
   

  

 D. Pricing \& Commercial Management
   

  

 \- Develop product pricing strategy based on:
   

 \- Manufacturing cost
   

 \- Landed cost
   

 \- Competitor pricing
   

 \- Clinical value
   

 \- Channel margins
   

 \- Customer segment
   

 \- Market positioning
   

 \- Recommend MRP, distributor/dealer pricing and institutional pricing.
   

 \- Monitor discounting and price realization.
   

 \- Develop tender and institutional pricing frameworks.
   

 \- Identify opportunities to improve category gross margin.
   

 \- Monitor profitability by product, customer segment and channel.
   

  

 E. Sales Enablement
   

  

 Work closely with the Sales team to increase conversion and category penetration.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop sales presentations and product literature.
   

 \- Create product comparison sheets.
   

 \- Develop competitive battle cards.
   

 \- Conduct regular product training for sales teams and distributors.
   

 \- Train sales personnel on clinical applications and product positioning.
   

 \- Support major customer meetings, product demonstrations and evaluations.
   

 \- Participate in important tenders and institutional negotiations.
   

 \- Support the sales team in converting strategic accounts.
   

  

 F. Surgeon \& Key Opinion Leader Engagement
   

  

 Build strong relationships with orthopedic surgeons, hospitals and clinical experts.
   

  

 \- Identify and develop Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs).
   

 \- Conduct surgeon feedback programs.
   

 \- Organize product demonstrations and workshops.
   

 \- Coordinate product evaluations at hospitals.
   

 \- Gather structured feedback on product performance and clinical usability.
   

 \- Identify emerging surgical techniques and applications.
   

 \- Develop surgeon advisory panels where appropriate.
   

 \- Convert clinical feedback into product\-development priorities.
   

  

 G. Channel \& Market Development
   

  

 \- Develop strategies for direct, dealer and distributor channels.
   

 \- Identify and onboard suitable channel partners.
   

 \- Define territory\-wise category opportunities.
   

 \- Develop distributor sales targets and business plans.
   

 \- Monitor distributor inventory and secondary sales.
   

 \- Identify underpenetrated states and territories.
   

 \- Support international expansion of the category where required.
   

 \- Develop market\-entry plans for new countries.
   

  

 H. Marketing \& Category Communication
   

  

 Work with the Marketing team to build the Orthopedic Power Systems brand and category.
   

  

 Responsibilities include:
   

  

 \- Develop category positioning and messaging.
   

 \- Plan product launches and campaigns.
   

 \- Create clinical and technical marketing content.
   

 \- Develop brochures, catalogues, videos and digital content.
   

 \- Support exhibitions, conferences and workshops.
   

 \- Plan surgeon engagement activities.
   

 \- Develop product demonstrations and educational material.
   

 \- Measure marketing effectiveness and lead conversion.
   

  

 I. Demand Planning \& Inventory
   

  

 Work closely with Sales, Production and Supply Chain to ensure the right product availability.
   

  

 \- Prepare monthly and annual demand forecasts.
   

 \- Translate sales plans into SKU\-level forecasts.
   

 \- Monitor inventory levels and ageing.
   

 \- Identify slow\-moving and obsolete inventory.
   

 \- Coordinate production planning based on demand.
   

 \- Ensure availability of critical handpieces, attachments, batteries and consumables.
   

 \- Monitor forecast accuracy.
   

 \- Work towards improving inventory turns and working capital efficiency.
   

  

 J. Service \& Product Lifecycle Management
   

  

 Work closely with the Service team to improve customer experience and product lifecycle economics.
   

  

 \- Analyse field failures and service complaints.
   

 \- Identify recurring product issues.
   

 \- Coordinate corrective actions with Engineering and Quality.
   

 \- Monitor warranty claims.
   

 \- Develop AMC/service opportunities.
   

 \- Identify opportunities for refurbishment, upgrades and replacement sales.
   

 \- Track installed base and replacement cycles.
   

 \- Develop strategies for consumable and accessory attachment.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

 The Category Manager will be evaluated on measurable business outcomes including:
   

  

 Commercial
   

  

 \- Category revenue growth
   

 \- Unit sales growth
   

 \- Gross margin
   

 \- Average selling price
   

 \- Price realization
   

 \- Product mix
   

 \- New customer acquisition
   

  

 Market
   

  

 \- Market share growth
   

 \- Number of active hospitals
   

 \- Number of active surgeons/users
   

 \- Geographic penetration
   

 \- Dealer/distributor productivity
   

  

 Product
   

  

 \- New product launches
   

 \- Launch success
   

 \- Product adoption
   

 \- Product lifecycle management
   

 \- Customer satisfaction
   

 \- Product quality feedback
   

  

 Channel
   

  

 \- Active distributors/dealers
   

 \- Distributor sales
   

 \- Secondary sales
   

 \- Dealer productivity
   

 \- Channel inventory
   

  

 Operational
   

  

 \- Forecast accuracy
   

 \- Inventory turns
   

 \- Slow\-moving inventory
   

 \- Product availability
   

 \- Warranty/service performance
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 4\. Cross\-Functional Responsibilities
   

  

 The Category Manager will work closely with:
   

  

 Function\| Primary Interaction
   

 Sales\| Revenue, pipeline, product conversion
   

 Marketing\| Category positioning and campaigns
   

 R\&D / Engineering\| Product development and roadmap
   

 Production\| Costing, capacity and product availability
   

 Quality \& Regulatory\| Compliance and product approvals
   

 Service\| Installed base, failures and lifecycle
   

 Supply Chain\| Forecasting and inventory
   

 Finance\| Pricing, margins and profitability
   

 Management\| Category strategy and business reviews
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 5\. Candidate Profile
   

  

 Education
   

  

 Preferred:
   

  

 \- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
   

 \- MBA in Marketing, Product Management or Business Management will be an advantage.
   

  

 Experience
   

  

 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in:
   

  

 \- Orthopedic medical devices
   

 \- Surgical instruments
   

 \- Orthopedic power tools
   

 \- Neurosurgical power tools
   

 \- Surgical equipment
   

 \- Medical device product management
   

 \- Medical device sales/business development
   

  

 Candidates with strong experience in orthopedic power tools, surgical drills, saws, shavers or related capital equipment will be preferred.
   

  

 Required Skills
   

  

 \- Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical procedures and applications.
   

 \- Product management experience.
   

 \- Commercial and business\-development orientation.
   

 \- Strong analytical and market\-research capabilities.
   

 \- Understanding of medical\-device distribution.
   

 \- Pricing and margin management.
   

 \- Excellent presentation and communication skills.
   

 \- Ability to interact confidently with orthopedic surgeons.
   

 \- Ability to work with engineering and technical teams.
   

 \- Strong negotiation skills.
   

 \- Willingness to travel extensively.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 6\. Desired Personal Attributes
   

  

 The ideal candidate should be:
   

  

 \- Commercially aggressive but analytically driven
   

 \- Customer and surgeon focused
   

 \- Strong in ownership and execution
   

 \- Comfortable working with ambiguity
   

 \- Data driven
   

 \- Curious about technology
   

 \- Strong at cross\-functional coordination
   

 \- Able to understand both clinical and commercial requirements
   

 \- Comfortable presenting to senior management
   

 \- Willing to spend significant time in the field
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 7\. What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Within the first 12 months, the Category Manager should be able to:
   

  

 1\. Establish a clear strategy for the Orthopedic Power Systems category.
   

 2\. Build a comprehensive competitor and market map.
   

 3\. Define the product portfolio and product roadmap.
   

 4\. Establish SKU\-level sales and demand forecasts.
   

 5\. Improve sales\-team product capability.
   

 6\. Build a structured surgeon/KOL engagement program.
   

 7\. Improve product conversion and market penetration.
   

 8\. Identify new product and portfolio opportunities.
   

 9\. Improve category gross margins and price realization.
   

 10\. Establish a measurable category review system with monthly business dashboards.
   

  

 \-\-\-
   

  

 8\. Role Philosophy
   

  

 This is not a conventional Product Manager role.
   

  

 The Category Manager is expected to operate as the business owner of Orthopedic Power Systems, with responsibility extending beyond product specifications into revenue, profitability, market development, customer adoption and portfolio growth.
   

  

 The role requires an individual who can move seamlessly between a surgeon discussion in the morning, a product\-development meeting in the afternoon and a commercial/business review with management in the evening.

title: Product Intelligence, Launch & Adoption Lead
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
 QAD is building a world\-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real\-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
   

  

**This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune with 3\-4 days of in\-office collaboration per week.**
**Job Description**
 QAD is hiring a senior operator to own three connected things: how we measure whether our products are working, how we launch new products into the market, and how we keep them adopted once they're live.
   

  

 The role owns the metrics layer across our product portfolio — telemetry, adoption analytics, value realization — and runs the operational mechanics of every product launch. After launch, you're the person who notices when usage decays, diagnoses why, and routes the fix to the right team. You'll partner closely with the Customer Success organization, which executes the customer\-facing side of adoption work under your diagnostic direction.
   

  

 This is the most operationally demanding seat on the Product Operations team and the one with the most cross\-functional surface area. It reports to the Head of Product Operations.
   

  

 What you'll own
   

  

* Own KPI governance and the metrics layer: workflow telemetry, adoption analytics, product\-health dashboards, decision outcomes vs. baseline. Standardize dual success metrics across the portfolio (product outcomes and model metrics) so teams know what "good enough" means at each capability tier.
* Own value\-realization tracking: prove ROI per launched product at the customer level. This evidence does two jobs — it informs stage\-gate decisions, and it underwrites the case for continued investment in the new product portfolio.
* Run NPI launch mechanics: launch readiness, enablement materials, sales and customer success playbooks, pricing\-and\-packaging coordination per product, and the cross\-functional launch calendar.
* Own adoption health monitoring across the entire shipped portfolio. Maintain the leading\-indicator dashboard. When sustained usage decay is flagged (with thresholds defined per product), trigger the adoption response protocol within 48 hours: pull evaluation signals, value\-realization data, and field notes; diagnose the root cause; route to the right owner.
* Be the single accountable owner of root\-cause diagnosis when adoption drops. Route product gaps to the product team, enablement gaps to Customer Success, and customer\-fit issues to the field deployment team. Customer Success executes the human\-side fix; you stay accountable for the signal and the routing.
* Run PM enablement: AI\-native methodology, templates, the experimentation cadence, and the training that helps product managers evolve into operators of AI\-powered products. Partner closely with the AI Quality \& Evaluation Lead so PM training on evaluation\-writing is integrated, not bolted on.
* Standardize the intake process for user feedback, feature requests, and field signals, and own the core product\-ops tool stack.


**Qualifications**
 What we're looking for
   

  

* 5\-8 years in product ops, product launch/GTM operations, customer\-success operations, or product analytics — with demonstrated ownership of at least two of the three (launch, analytics, adoption).
* Hands\-on experience launching products in a multi\-SKU enterprise environment; bonus if you've owned a post\-launch adoption motion working with a separate Customer Success team.
* Strong analytics: dashboards, partnering with data teams to build self\-serve analytics for product managers, SQL and spreadsheet automation expected.
* Strong facilitator who can hold a cross\-functional diagnostic conversation. The job is calling the right meeting at the right time and making sure the right four humans are in it.
* Backbone, in a different flavor than the Head's. You will need to tell Customer Success leadership "this is not an enablement problem, please don't run that playbook" — and be right.
* Curiosity about the AI landscape; you don't need to build evaluations but you need to read them.


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea\-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set


**About QAD**
 QAD \| Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD \| Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
   

  

 QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
   

  

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: Product Engineering Leader
description:
**Position Summary:** 




 This role is for a product engineering leader who will lead Japan Core Insurance Systems (CIS) delivery from MGCC, India, and drive a broad Quality Engineering and QA automation transformation. The leader is expected to be AI\-first in engineering practice: shaping the Agentic Development Lifecycle (ADLC), embedding AI and automation into SDLC/ADLC workflows, and building or contributing to agentic platforms, engineering agents, testing agents, and reusable accelerators that improve speed, quality, predictability, and developer experience.
 



  





**Role positioning:** 
 Insurance, policy administration, or PAS exposure is useful but optional. The primary requirement is proven product engineering leadership with hands\-on, AI\-first transformation across engineering and quality.
 



  





**Scope \& Business Impact:** 



* Lead Japan CIS delivery, operational stability, quality outcomes, and financial governance from MGCC, India.
* Drive AI\-first engineering practices across delivery, quality engineering, release readiness, and production stability.
* Lead the QA automation and Quality Engineering transformation for Japan technology deliverables.
* Establish agentic SDLC/ADLC patterns that improve developer productivity, test effectiveness, defect prevention, and delivery predictability.
* Partner with Japan technology leaders, product owners, architecture, operations, risk, and vendors to deliver measurable business and engineering outcomes.
* Enable faster change, stronger engineering discipline, improved quality, operational resilience, and transparent delivery economics.



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Product Engineering Leadership for CIS** 



* Provide end\-to\-end technology leadership for Japan CIS, including delivery, engineering discipline, operational stability, security, risk management, and financial outcomes.
* Operate as a product engineering leader, balancing business priorities, platform reliability, technical debt reduction, engineering standards, and delivery accountability.
* Partner with Japan stakeholders to shape roadmaps, define measurable outcomes, and ensure India delivery is aligned to Japan portfolio priorities.
* Drive modern engineering practices such as API enablement, modularization, data modernization, observability, DevSecOps, and engineering governance where relevant to platform evolution.



  





**AI\-First SDLC / ADLC Transformation** 



* Lead adoption of the Agentic Development Lifecycle (ADLC), embedding AI and automation into requirements analysis, design, coding, code review, test generation, defect triage, release readiness, documentation, and production support workflows.
* Actively contribute to ADLC practices by helping define patterns, reusable assets, guardrails, metrics, and adoption playbooks for AI\-assisted engineering.
* Sponsor and/or directly contribute to agentic platform capabilities, including engineering agents, testing agents, quality agents, knowledge agents, and workflow orchestration that support SDLC/ADLC use cases.
* Ensure AI adoption is governed, secure, measurable, and practical for engineers, with clear controls for quality, risk, data handling, and human oversight.
* Measure impact through cycle\-time improvement, automation coverage, defect leakage reduction, quality signals, engineering productivity, reuse, and adoption maturity.



  





**Quality Engineering \& QA Automation Transformation** 



* Own QA and Quality Engineering strategy for Japan technology deliverables, moving from manual, phase\-based testing to automation\-first and AI\-assisted continuous quality engineering.
* Embed automated testing, test data practices, regression optimization, service virtualization, shift\-left quality, and quality gates into Agile and CI/CD delivery models.
* Use AI and intelligent automation for test design, test\-case generation, impact analysis, regression selection, defect prediction, test coverage insights, and quality reporting.
* Establish common QA platforms, metrics, standards, and governance across portfolios while improving speed, stability, and production quality.



  





**Financial, Vendor \& Delivery Governance** 



* Own and manage technology budgets for Japan platforms delivered from MGCC, India, including planning, forecasting, cost transparency, and value realization.
* Govern strategic partners and vendors to align with product engineering, automation\-first delivery, AI\-enabled quality, and measurable outcome commitments.
* Strengthen operating cadence, portfolio transparency, dependency management, risk mitigation, and stakeholder communication across India and Japan teams.



  





**Talent \& Capability Building** 



* Build strong product engineering, quality engineering, automation, AI engineering, and platform capability within the India team.
* Upskill teams toward AI\-first engineering roles, including prompt patterns, agentic workflows, test automation craftsmanship, engineering discipline, and secure use of AI tools.
* Develop leadership depth, succession, and communities of practice across engineering, QA automation, and ADLC adoption.



  





**Knowledge, Skills \& Experience** 



* 15\+ years of technology leadership experience with ownership of large engineering teams, complex platforms, delivery outcomes, financial governance, and senior stakeholder management.
* Strong product engineering mindset with experience improving engineering standards, platform reliability, delivery predictability, and developer experience.
* Demonstrated experience driving AI\-first engineering transformation across SDLC or ADLC practices.
* Hands\-on or sponsorship experience with Agentic AI for engineering, including agentic platforms, SDLC/ADLC agents, automation accelerators, workflow orchestration, and engineering productivity use cases.
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-scale QA / Quality Engineering transformation, including automation strategy, CI/CD integration, test architecture, metrics, and governance.
* Experience with modern engineering practices such as cloud\-aligned modernization, APIs, DevSecOps, observability, data modernization, platform engineering, and engineering controls.
* Strong financial discipline, vendor governance, operational risk awareness, and ability to connect technology investment to business value.
* Experience working with Japan, Asia, or other cross\-border stakeholders is strongly preferred.
* Insurance, policy administration, PAS, agent commission, or financial\-services platform experience is beneficial but optional; it is not a mandatory prerequisite for this role.



  





**Personal Characteristics** 



* AI\-first, engineering\-led transformation leader with a pragmatic delivery mindset.
* Hands\-on enough to shape platforms, patterns, and agentic engineering practices, while senior enough to lead strategy, governance, and stakeholder alignment.
* Balances innovation with controls, security, quality, operational resilience, and financial discipline.
* Collaborative, culturally aware, outcome\-driven, and comfortable working across India and Japan leadership teams.
* Strong people leader who can build confidence, capability, and adoption across engineering and QA teams.

CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
   

  

 As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn't changed — we're here to stop breaches, and we've redefined modern security with the world's most advanced AI\-native platform. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're also a mission\-driven company. We cultivate a culture that gives every CrowdStriker both the flexibility and autonomy to own their careers. We're always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
   

  

****About The Role:****
 The Exposure Management product team is seeking an experienced, technical Product Manager who is collaborative and excited about building great products. In this role, you will bring deep knowledge of vulnerability management to help expand CrowdStrike's exposure and risk data model across a growing portfolio of proactive security capabilities — vulnerability management, external attack surface management, cloud security, container security, supply chain security, and code security.
   

  

 You will work closely with engineering, data science, product marketing, sales, support, and other product managers across the Exposure Management portfolio. You will apply product management best practices to deliver significant new features and enhancements that extend visibility, prioritization, and remediation across the full software and infrastructure lifecycle. The successful candidate will have the ability to interface and influence cross\-functional teams throughout the company.
   

  

****What You'll Do:****
* Define and maintain strategy and product roadmap for CrowdStrike's Exposure Management team in concert with other PMs and stakeholders
* Act as the product leader for major initiatives that expand the platform's exposure vulnerability detection capabilities, integrations, and risk scoring across vulnerability, cloud, container, and code security domains.
* Partner with engineering to prioritize and ship features that improve vulnerability detection, prioritization, and remediation workflows
* Engage with sales and support to champion recent releases and guide future product direction
* Conduct competitive analyses and maintain current information regarding competitive activity in vulnerability management and cloud\-native security markets
* Work on a team of high\-performing product professionals in a highly collaborative environment


****What You'll Need:****
* 10\+ years of product management experience with strong domain expertise in Vulnerability Management
* Strong domain experience with cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud security concepts, including cloud workload protection and infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) security
* Working knowledge of DevSecOps and shift\-left security practices across the software development lifecycle
* BS degree in an applicable field; Master's preferred

**Title And Summary**
 Lead Product Manager \- Technical

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

 They will bring a strong interest in Payments domain, along with proven technical leadership, and the ability to think creatively applying innovative, out\-of\-the\-box approaches to solve complex problems
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Customer obsession: Champion a deep understanding of customer needs, the broader ecosystem, and key market dynamics, and embed these insights into product decisions
* Systems analysis \& design: Develop an in\-depth understanding of the product platform and its surrounding ecosystem; produce high\-quality functional artifacts for Engineering, including data flows, sequence diagrams, APIs, and interface specifications
* Backlog management: Define and maintain a clear roadmap aligned to business objectives; translate system designs into well\-structured features and user stories that are ready for Engineering execution
* Story elaboration: Lead refinement sessions and create detailed, comprehensive acceptance criteria to ensure clarity and delivery readiness
* Technical analysis: Provide rigorous analysis of application software to validate that business and functional requirements can be effectively delivered
* Strategic alignment: Partner with stakeholders to ensure backlogs are prioritized and refined based on business value, impact, and measurable outcomes
* Agile mindset: Advocate for and model agile best practices across the product lifecycle—from defining epics to writing actionable user stories and acceptance criteria
* Continuous improvement: Measure outcomes, evaluate existing practices and metrics, and drive ongoing optimization across processes, roles, and delivery execution


**All About You**
* Proven product experience: Several years of product management or new product development experience delivering high\-quality products, with the ability to clearly articulate business context and customer use cases
* Technical product expertise: Experience managing highly technical platforms or API\-driven services, with strong software architecture and systems design knowledge
* ISO8583 knowledge (preferred): Familiarity with key payments and dispute management concepts is a plus
* Lean \& Agile delivery: Hands\-on experience with Lean product management and agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), along with CI/CD and modern DevOps practices
* End\-to\-end ownership: Demonstrated success delivering features from design through development, deployment, and customer integration
* Backlog management: Expertise in grooming epics, features, and user stories; defining clear acceptance and exit criteria; and effectively prioritizing platform backlogs
* Data\-driven decision making: Ability to define and leverage SMART metrics (leading and lagging) to guide product strategy and measure success
* Collaboration \& stakeholder management: Proven ability to work across global, cross\-functional teams, align diverse perspectives, and manage dependencies and co\-development opportunities
* Thrives in ambiguity: Comfortable navigating uncertainty; proactively identifies solutions, engages the right stakeholders, and drives clarity
* Continuous improvement \& communication: Committed to optimizing team processes for speed, quality, and innovation, with excellent written and verbal communication skills


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Solution Analyst - Supply Chain Planning
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 Vertiv is transforming and digitizing supply chain capabilities by re\-engineering business processes and implementing advanced technologies/systems that powers world‑class operations, customer experiences, and AI‑driven decision\-making.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Solution Analyst – Supply Chain Planning** 
 for our Digital Supply Solutions group. This leader acts as a Product manager and is responsible for end\-to\-end planning systems capabilities from strategy, business stakeholder management, portfolio prioritization and delivery/maintenance of planning capabilities to support Vertiv’s business units. The position provides subject matter expertise in various domains of supply chain planning (demand, supply, manufacturing etc.) a hands\-on systems knowledge and experience/exposure to AI in supply chain opportunities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Responsible for implementation of Advanced Planning capabilities and owns specific domain area : Demand/S\&OP or Supply/Inventory/Manufacturing Planning or Spares Parts Planning solutions
* Design robust touch\-less digital planning solutions for scale, availability and growth
* Owns and drives deliverables through SDLC
* Manges portfolio of digital supply chain programs in the specific domain area of ownership
* Works across teams and external partners to drive major transformation program in specific domain area
* Scope, plan, and manage projects, quality of software development, risks, schedules, communication plans, and deliverables.
* Responsible for building a global template of domain specific capabilities and rollouts across 33\+ and growing plants around the world
* Build supply chain planning capabilities as a Product

* Responsible for standardizing the planning global template and baselining with industry and tool standards
* Owns and manages relevant KPIs
* Revolutionize end\-to\-end supply chain models
* Serve as a senior technical mentor to data engineers, solution architects, and product teams
* Introduce best practices, emerging patterns, and modern architectural approaches
* Influence stakeholders across business and technology with strong communication, storytelling, and technical depth


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Math, Statistics, or related field. MBA or master’s preferred but not required.
* 4\+ years of progressive experience in implementing complex supply chain solutions, strong knowledge of operational processes, systems, and tools implementation experience in leading/fast growth companies
* Deep domain expertise in supply chain planning across two or more areas : demand forecasting, S\&OP, multi\-level integrated supply planning, distribution, inventory optimization, manufacturing planning and scheduling, ATP/CTP
* Multiple E2E implementations of advanced planning technologies implementing Kinaxis Rapidresponse/Maestro
* Extensive, hands\-on experience in supply chain complex solution design including authoring, data integrations, scenario planning and best practices
* Proven experience translating business processes into scalable digital solutions
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain processes and supply chain strategies (ETO/CTO, MEIO, VMI etc)
* Preferred
+ Kinaxis Maestro authoring and solution consultant certifications
+ Experience enabling AI/ML for supply chain use cases
+ Prior experience with global manufacturing environments

title: Electronic Systems Technical Specialist - Tools
description:
**Job Summary**
 The System Requirements Engineer is responsible for translating business and stakeholder needs into clear, complete, and verifiable technical requirements for electronic tools and embedded software systems. The role involves defining functional and non\-functional requirements, documenting system interfaces and boundaries, identifying failure cases, supporting FMEA activities, and leading structured problem\-solving with cross\-functional stakeholders.
   

  

 The position works closely with product, software development, testing, supplier, and customer teams to ensure requirements are well understood, traceable, and aligned with product and business needs. The role also contributes to the development, verification, and continuous improvement of electronic tools and associated engineering processes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Understand business, customer, and stakeholder needs and translate them into clear functional and non\-functional technical requirements .
* Create, document, review, and maintain System Requirement Specifications (SRS) and Functional Requirement Specifications (FRS) .
* Analyze component and supplier interfaces, including libraries, to identify gaps, dependencies, and requirements for changing product needs.
* Define system boundaries, interfaces, dependencies, and interactions through boundary diagrams, flow charts, and system\-level documentation .
* Identify potential failure cases during requirements development and support the preparation and review of FMEA documents.
* Establish acceptance criteria and ensure requirements are complete, consistent, testable, and traceable throughout the product lifecycle.
* Lead structured problem\-solving activities with customers, development, testing, and other key stakeholders to resolve technical issues and close knowledge gaps.
* Investigate electronic tools and software\-related problems, identify causal mechanisms, recommend solutions, and document problem resolution.
* Collaborate with product and software development teams to support the delivery and verification of software features, components, builds, and engineering tools.
* Support requirements, design, development, testing, and release activities for electronic tools used in the development, service, and manufacturing of Cummins products.
* Participate in system architecture, requirements, design, and verification discussions and provide technical recommendations.
* Assess the impact of requirement changes on project scope, schedule, resources, and related system components.
* Support product verification and validation by ensuring requirements are linked to appropriate test cases and acceptance criteria.
* Contribute to the improvement of requirements engineering processes, tools, and work practices.
* Work effectively with global cross\-functional teams and take ownership of assigned deliverables to ensure timely completion.
* Support knowledge sharing and provide guidance to less\-experienced engineers and team members as required.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Electronics, Automotive Engineering, or another relevant STEM discipline.
* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred for select roles.
* Relevant certifications or training in systems engineering, requirements engineering, Agile/SCRUM, or FMEA would be an advantage.


**Skills \& Experience**
* Prior experience in system requirements engineering, systems engineering, embedded software, electronic tools, or a related technical discipline .
* Strong ability to translate business and customer requirements into detailed technical requirements.
* Experience creating and maintaining SRS/FRS and requirements documentation .
* Experience with requirements management tools such as Integrity ; knowledge of DOORS is an advantage.
* Experience creating flow charts, system context diagrams, and boundary diagrams using Visio, Microsoft Word, or similar tools.
* Good understanding of system interfaces, dependencies, functional decomposition, and requirements traceability.
* Experience identifying failure cases during requirements development and exposure to FMEA methodologies.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills.
* Good understanding of software/product development, testing, verification, and validation processes.
* Knowledge of SCRUM/Agile methodology is an advantage.
* Experience documenting requirements for mobile platforms such as Android or iOS is preferred.
* Automotive domain experience, particularly in embedded systems or electronic products, is preferred.
* Knowledge of PC/mobile software platforms, embedded systems, software lifecycle tools, and configuration/change management is beneficial.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical information to diverse stakeholders.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and ability to work independently in a fast\-paced and demanding environment.
* Good team\-player skills with a willingness to learn new applications, products, and technologies.
* Ability to manage complexity, make sound technical decisions, and deliver quality results within committed timelines.


 Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools is preferred.

title: Enterprise Product Manager
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
   

  

**About Snowflake**
 Founded by industry experts and backed by strategic investors, our disruptive built\-for\-the\-cloud architecture was designed to push the limitations of conventional data warehousing. Our teams breed ambition, challenge ordinary thinking, push the pace of innovation, and work hard to provide our customers with the best experience possible.
   

  

 As an Enterprise Product Manager, your key role will be to optimize and strategically evolve Workday Finance Order to Cash (OTC) IT Systems at Snowflake. You will bridge diverse business stakeholders and skilled development teams, translating complex business requirements into precise, actionable functional specifications for technical implementations.
   

  

 This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the entire solution lifecycle for critical OTC systems, from design to deployment. Your expertise will directly impact the efficiency, scalability, and accuracy of Snowflake's revenue\-generating processes, ensuring a robust OTC ecosystem.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
 As an Enterprise Product Manager, you will independently contribute to and lead the following areas:
   

  

* Process Optimization: Optimize and strategically evolve Workday Finance Order to Cash (OTC) systems, bridging business needs with technical solutions.
* Operational Excellence: Independently contribute to Customer Contracts, Billing, Collections, Invoices, and Settlements, as well as OTC period close activities.
* Transformation Projects: Lead and participate in Order Management and Billing transformation projects and large\-scale operational changes.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with other business application owners to ensure smooth business automation and data management processes across the ecosystem.
* Roadmap \& Strategy: Provide expert input into the IT Roadmap, including Workday new feature rollouts, major releases, and the implementation of new modules.
* Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and champion in driving industry best practices for the evolution of Snowflake’s OTC business users.
* Agile Leadership: Organize various scrum ceremonies (daily standups, sprint planning, retrospectives) using agile methodology.
* Quality \& Training: Lead quality assurance by defining testing strategies, identifying risks, and assisting in the creation of training materials and release notes for OTC users.


**Key Duties include:**
* Gathering and translating complex business requirements from diverse stakeholders into actionable functional specifications.
* Working with cross\-functional teams to develop comprehensive design and solution documents.
* Managing communications and change processes for all new changes on the platform.
* Developing and executing test scripts for UAT, post\-sprint, and regression testing.
* Ensuring system issues are identified, tracked, and resolved in a timely manner.


**What We Need To See**
* Education: A Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably with an emphasis in Information Systems or Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
* Experience: Minimum 8\+ years of direct experience working on Order to Cash (OTC) implementations or operations as a Business Systems Analyst or Product Manager.
* Technical Expertise: Expert knowledge of Workday systems or similar ERPs (Oracle Apps, Peoplesoft, SAP) specifically in OTC modules like Quoting, Revenue, Billing, and Collections.
+ Experience integrating custom or 3rd\-party applications with Workday or other ERPs.
+ Basic understanding and working knowledge of Databases, including writing SQL queries.

* Functional Knowledge: Superior understanding of OTC concepts and principles, including Quoting processes, Billings, Cash Applications, and New Product Introductions (NPI).
* Skills: Highly developed written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
+ Strong attention to detail, goal\-oriented mindset, and the ability to adapt to changing requirements.
+ Expert leadership and collaboration skills with the ability to build relationships with stakeholders ranging from executive to line level.
+ Commitment to excellent customer service and a strong focus on quality.

* Ability: Proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.


 Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
   

  

 How do you want to make your impact?

description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Advisor, Product Delivery
   

  

**What does a successful Product Owner do at Fiserv?**
 The Product Owner (PO) s responsible for maximizing the value delivered by the team and ensuring that the Team Backlog is aligned with customer and stakeholder needs. The PO is the team’s primary customer advocate and primary link to business and technology strategy. This enables the team to balance the needs of multiple stakeholders while continuously evolving the Solution.
   

  

 The PO represents the needs of customers and the business within a particular Solution domain, which is typically co\-represented by a Product Manager. Together, they ensure that product strategy and implementation remain connected throughout the value stream. Serving as the ‘voice of the customer’ for the team entails a broad range of responsibilities. The PO must build and manage key relationships, synthesize information from multiple sources, maintain business alignment in the Team Backlog, and communicate effectively with a variety of audiences—all with a bias toward delivering, and learning, quickly.
   

  

 The PO is ultimately responsible for maximizing the value delivered by the Agile team, which requires the PO to ensure that the right solutions are built and that they are built the right way. However, the PO cannot accomplish this alone. Building the right solutions requires deep knowledge of business strategy, customer segments, market dynamics, and value stream economics. The PO establishes a close relationship with Product Management to derive these macro\-level insights and apply them to specific product domains. Building solutions the right way requires Team and Technical Agility, DevOps practices, and a Continuous Delivery Pipeline. These technical capabilities determine the speed and quality with which value can be delivered, and the PO relies on the Agile team to provide them. The PO provides a crucial link in the bi\-directional information flow between Product Management and the Agile team. As shown in Figure 2, the PO keeps the Agile team informed of the strategy that drives product design and keeps Product Management informed of the innovations that influence the evolution of product strategy. Customer feedback aligns thinking from strategy through execution and is accessible to all roles.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* The PO, in close partnership with Product Management, applies a customer\-centric mindset along with design thinking tools to guide the team toward delivering solutions that are desirable, viable, feasible, and sustainable.
* The PO must understand what solutions and experiences the teams can deliver. This practical insight is a valuable contribution to the vision and roadmaps that guide solution implementation.
* In collaboration with Product Management, System Architects, Delivery Management and other stakeholders, POs help guide the sequencing of features over time toward the best economic outcomes. Through their understanding of which problems need to be solved, which solutions would best solve them, and the feasibility of delivering those solutions, POs help ensure that the vision and roadmap are reflected in the Jira Project Backlog.
* The PO should communicate the vision and roadmap during PI Planning to ensure teams are aligned and ready to execute against them.
* It is the PO’s responsibility to ensure that they are well\-formed and aligned with product strategy. The PO clarifies story details, applies user\-story voice, ensures ‘INVEST’ characteristics are present, assists with story splitting, defines enablers, and incorporates behavior\-driven design (BDD) to ensure stories support continuous value flow. The PO also allows space for ‘local’ stories and spikes that advance product design but are not derived explicitly from the strategic roadmap.
* Achieving continuous value flow requires that the highest\-value backlog items are delivered in the shortest sustainable lead time and in the right sequence. The PO enables this by regularly ordering backlog items according to their cost of delay and communicating that sequence to the team during backlog refinement
* The PO works with the team to agree on accepted story completion. This includes validating that the story meets acceptance criteria, that it has the appropriate, persistent acceptance tests, and that it otherwise complies with its Definition of Done (DoD). In so doing, the PO assures that quality is built in.
* POs facilitate frequent conversations with their teams to resolve questions, manage dependencies, and communicate priorities that emerge as stories are implemented. This information also helps the team slice stories effectively to achieve increased velocity and shortened learning cycles.
* The PO regularly evaluates progress toward story acceptance criteria, including compliance with Built\-In\-Quality criteria, such as the scalable definition of done, and non\-functional requirements (NFRs). The PO works closely with the team to detect quality issues as they are introduced and correct them in or near real time.
* As a member of the Agile team, the PO attends and actively participates in team events during PI execution. During iteration planning, backlog refinement, iteration reviews, team retrospectives, and team syncs, the PO provides crucial feedback on the team’s work from an outside\-in, customer\-centric point of view. By participating in PO Sync and System Demos, the PO helps the team satisfy dependencies, demonstrate incremental value, and maintain cadence with the roadmap.
* The PO collects and shares feedback with Product Management and System Architects as part of Continuous Exploration, with their teams during backlog refinement, iteration planning, and iteration reviews, system demos, and, if applicable, Inspect and Adapt events.


**What You Will Need To Have**
* Degree or equivalent experience
* 5 \+ years relevant experience in the Fintech sector
* Extensive Agile experience preferably with a recognised Product Owner certification
* Proven track record of managing a complex product backlog for delivery through regular refinement and prioritisation
* Experience in delivering a new product from inception to market/live
* Expert in User Story and Acceptance criteria creation, coaching and review
* Great communication and meeting facilitation skills
* Experience in managing and developing team members
* Expert in defining success criteria and creating meaningful reporting through the use of metrics and empirical measurements
* International travel may be required
* Strong verbal, written and organizational skills; strong customer orientation
* Ability to prioritise
* Pro\-active approach in meeting agreed deadlines
* Committed to clients and to delivery
* Strong analysis skills; tenacious, determined, interested in detail
* Strong document\-writing ability
* Quality\-focused, with attention to detail, good use of language (proficient with Word, Excel PowerPoint, Visio), familiarity with Jira and Confluence tools.
* Ability to adapt to different situations; Clients, technical requirements, business outputs
* Organised; analysis and documentation must follow pre\-determined project methodologies
* Present information to / illicit relevant information from stakeholders with ease
* Flexible
* Project and Process Management


**What Would Be Great To Have**
* 2\+ years of experience in defining and implementing the security architecture of enterprise applications within the .NET family.
* 2\+ years of experience with SQL Server and other relational databases.
* Knowledge of tools and testing approaches such as AppScan, Burp Proxy, Sonar, and Coverity.
* Experience in the printing domain.
* Extensive experience in Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies such as Agile/Scrum and waterfall.
* Ability to gather requirements, translate them into technical design, and guide teams through implementation.

We cultivate a culture of inclusion (https://www.mastercard.us/en\-us/vision/who\-we\-are/diversity\-inclusion.html) for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.
   

  

 Job Title
   

  

 Global Product Manager, Virtual Card Platform
   

  

**Overview**
 Global Business\-to\-Business (B2B) payment flows represent a $125T opportunity. Most of it happens on non\-card rails, representing tremendous growth opportunity for Mastercard’s Commercial Cards business. Accelerating the adoption of Commercial Payments is a strategic imperative for Mastercard and this role is critical to our team meeting our growth aspirations.
   

  

 The In Control platform for Commercial Payments (ICCP) and In Control for Business Travel (ICBT) are part of the Commercial Platform family that is responsible for delivering safe, smart, and simple payment solutions to middle and large market segment supporting both travel (T\&E) and B2B payments. The In Control platform (https://www.mastercard.com/incontroldemo/en/home.html) is a key to driving core brand and services revenue for the middle and large market commercial segments, supporting both T\&E and B2B payments.
   

  

 The Mastercard Product Management team leads the launch and delivery of the platform. As a member of this team, you will have the chance to shape and influence the platform using your customer insights and product development capabilities. As a Product Manager, you will become a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on the In Control platform and work closely with engineering team and regional account teams to deliver world class B2B payment products to Mastercard customers.
   

  

 In addition, this role is heavily involved in defining the overall Platform vision, including enhancement support, testing and release support.
   

  

**The Successful Candidate’s Primary Responsibilities Will Be To**
* Work closely with engineering scrum teams to deliver products that meet business requirements
* Drive development of new products in anticipation of or response to customer needs, market trends, and competitive opportunities
* Engage directly with regional teams to support partners and customers on product roadmap, product implementation and demos
* Generate and evaluate ideas to enhance Mastercard’s suite of product offerings and create a competitive advantage


**Role**
 This role requires the successful candidate to:
   

  

* Translate product requirements into technical specifications, ensuring mutual understanding between business/customers and engineering to deliver high quality products
* Interact successfully with Product, Technology and Operations support staff to meet the needs of our customers
* Develop deep knowledge of payment processing and the overall commercial business
* Validate technical delivery and ensure that delivered functionality complies with the product requirements and is fit\-for\-purpose
* Curiosity to develop a long\-term vision for virtual card and tokenized payments to capture market share


**All About You**
 Background preferred in one or more of the following:
   

  

* Product management and development
* Agile development
* Customer engagement / Business development
* Go\-to\-market planning and execution
* Technology Development \& Operations
* Commercial payments
* Demonstrated success in building relationships and delivering results with global, multi\-cultural and remote project teams
* Outstanding communication and presentation skills
* Strong analytical skills with ability to drive deep product insights from data
* Ability to take independent action and be comfortable interacting with varying levels of leadership across the organization, both internal and external
* Strong ability to interact with, influence, and build consensus across a variety of internal business units, external partners, and service providers
* Familiarity with PME framework
* UX/UI Design skill set not required but plus
* Undergraduate degree required with min 5\-7 years of experience. MBA preferred


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Company Description**
 Entain India is the engineering and delivery powerhouse for Entain, one of the world's leading global sports and gaming groups. Established in Hyderabad in 2001, we've grown from a small tech hub into a dynamic force, delivering cutting\-edge software solutions and support services that power billions of transactions for millions of users worldwide.
   

  

 Our focus on quality at scale drives us to create innovative technology that supports Entain's mission to lead the change in global sports and gaming sector. At Entain India, we make the impossible possible, togethe
   

  

**Job Description**
 As a Product Manager, you'll bring your product expertise into a new way of working. You won't just write specs and manage roadmaps — you'll define missions, validate outcomes with data, and use AI to accelerate discovery, analysis, and delivery. You'll work in a small, mission\-driven cross\-functional team called a pod — three functions (Product, Engineer, Quality) with high agency, shared ownership, and no hand\-offs.
   

  

 Reporting to the Product Leader, you'll join the Product \& Technology Team. Are you ready to be part of a team that's redefining how products get built in an AI Native setup?
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Define and own the pod's mission — the business outcome, the target customer, the success metrics.
* Validate ideas with data and customer insight before committing the pod to build.
* Use AI agents for discovery, competitive analysis, spec writing, and backlog health.
* Write specs that both humans and AI can parse — clear acceptance criteria, clear "why".
* Operate in continuous flow (Kanban) — prioritise ruthlessly, respect WIP limits, ship daily.
* Map dependencies and integration points across teams. Unblock the pod before it gets blocked.
* Get your hands dirty — prototype, script, or contribute code with AI assistance when it moves the mission faster.
* Understand the engineering decisions behind the product — architecture trade\-offs, system constraints, deployment impact.
* Track mission KPIs in production and use outcomes to steer what comes next.
* Collaborate across pods, stakeholders, and commercial partners spanning multiple geographies.


**Qualifications**
 Engineering Mindset — What We Look For
   

  

**We Assess Every Candidate Across Six Core Dimensions**
* AI Fluency — AI is the primary way we engineer. You prompt, evaluate, iterate. Manual coding is a deliberate choice, not the default.
* Cross\-Functional Versatility — "That's not my area" doesn't exist. You contribute beyond your discipline, share openly, and communicate clearly across formats.
* Customer and Value Awareness — Ask "why" and "for whom" before "how". Zoom out to see the business, zoom in to trace the bug. Map dependencies before you build.
* Craft — Pride in the quality of what you create — specs, prototypes, or code with AI assistance. Clear structure, attention to detail, and a bar that applies to every artefact you ship.
* Technical Curiosity — Build a prototype and break it before reading the docs. Stay curious about how things work.
* Agency \& Entrepreneurship — Don't wait for permission. Own outcomes end\-to\-end, make others successful, challenge the status quo.


**Must Have**
* Experienced Product Manager with a track record of delivering excellent digital experiences.
* Strong product strategy, discovery, and prioritisation skills — RICE, impact mapping, or equivalent.
* Ability to write clear specs and acceptance criteria that engineering and AI agents can act on.
* Data\-driven decision making — comfortable with KPIs, A/B testing, analytics, and customer research.
* Proficiency with AI\-assisted workflows — using AI for discovery, competitive analysis, spec writing, and validation.
* Experience managing dependencies and stakeholders across international, cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent communication skills — written, verbal, and presentation — with the ability to adjust for audience.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, and product lifecycle tooling.
* Ability to mentor other Product Managers — onboarding new PMs and supporting the growth of peers through coaching and knowledge\-sharing.


**Nice to Have**
* Ability to write or modify code with AI assistance — prototyping, scripting, or contributing small changes directly.
* Engineering degree or technical background — able to engage confidently in architecture and system design discussions.
* Experience with agent systems, AI evaluation, or building AI\-augmented product workflows.
* Background in industries with strict regulatory requirements (gaming, financial services, healthcare).
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, or working directly with design systems.


**Additional Information**
 Additional Information

title: Product Manager (Core Platform and Infrastructure)
description:
**About Sibros Technologies**
****Who We Are****
 Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected Platform™ that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Adaptable to any vehicle architecture, Sibros’ platform meets stringent safety, security, and compliance standards, propelling OEMs to innovate new connected vehicle use cases across fleet management, predictive maintenance, data monetization, and beyond.
   

  

 Learn more at www.sibros.tech.
   

  

****Our Mission****
 Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices.
   

  

 Follow us on
   

  

 LinkedIn \| Youtube \| Instagram
   

  

**About The Role**
****Job Title:****
 Product Manager \- Core Platform \& Infrastructure
   

  

****Reporting to:****
 Group Product Manager
   

  

****Job Type:****
 Full\-Time
   

  

****Experience:****
 5\+ years
   

  

 As a Product Manager for Core Infrastructure at Sibros, you aren't just managing a backlog \- you are the architect of the foundational pipeline that connects vehicles to the cloud. You will sit at the intersection of embedded automotive systems, distributed cloud computing, and business strategy. We are looking for a highly technical product leader who can navigate the complex, high\-stakes landscape of modern vehicle architectures. You will own the core platforms that orchestrate flawless over\-the\-air (OTA) updates, secure remote diagnostics, and resilient vehicle\-to\-cloud data ingestion, transforming complex technical constraints into a highly reliable, scalable enterprise platform.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Own the Core Vehicle\-to\-Cloud Pipeline: Lead the full product lifecycle for our foundational infrastructure products, including OTA orchestration engines and remote command delivery. You will ensure this core platform acts as a rock\-solid, extensible foundation that reliably powers all downstream applications built on top of it, such as advanced troubleshooting, predictive maintenance, and fleet management tools.
* Optimize Value Delivery: Ruthlessly prioritize the platform backlog. You’ll make the hard trade\-off decisions between technical debt, architectural scalability, security compliance, and OEM feature requests to maximize platform ROI.
* Define System Boundaries and APIs: Partner closely with Embedded, Cloud, and Security Engineering to define robust APIs, data contracts, and platform abstractions that allow Sibros to integrate seamlessly into diverse OEM vehicle architectures.
* Drive Platform Reliability \& Scale: Define and track critical platform KPIs (e.g. OTA success rates, command latency, system uptime) and use technical discovery to address architectural bottlenecks proactively.
* Autonomous Decision\-Making: Act as the primary authority for your platform infrastructure domain, synthesizing deeply technical constraints and market requirements into a clear, prioritized roadmap without requiring day\-to\-day tactical guidance.
* Cross\-Functional Technical Leadership: Interface with Business Development, Solutions Architecture, and Engineering to translate complex OEM infrastructure requirements into scalable, platform\-agnostic solutions that serve diverse vehicle segments.


 What you should know
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Professional Experience: 5\+ years of Product Management experience in high\-growth environments, with a proven track record of delivering deeply technical platform products, infrastructure, or middleware at scale.
* Automotive \& Mobility Domain Expertise: Strong understanding of the vehicle architecture ecosystem, including telemetry, automotive communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet), and diagnostic standards (UDS, SOVD).
* Systems Thinking \& Scale: Experience managing backend or platform products that bridge embedded edge environments and distributed cloud infrastructure. You design with the entire ecosystem in mind, ensuring that changes to the core platform account for, support, and align with upstream OEM workflows, downstream applications, and broader data dependencies.
* Strategic Autonomy: You are a principled, self\-directed leader with a history of making high\-stakes technical decisions independently. You excel at navigating ambiguity and establishing clear technical directions in a fast\-paced environment.
* Technical Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex architectural constraints and infrastructure concepts into strategic business value for executive stakeholders and OEM partners.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Automotive Cybersecurity \& Safety Standards: Familiarity with functional safety (ISO 26262\), automotive cybersecurity (ISO 21434\).
* Engineering Roots: A background in Embedded Software, Cloud Systems Architecture, or Systems Engineering is highly desirable.
* Enterprise Integration: Experience building developer\-facing tools, SDKs, or highly flexible APIs used by third\-party enterprise engineering groups.


 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive compensation package with performance incentives.
* A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and the opportunity for rapid career advancement.
* Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
* Flexible working hours to accommodate different time zones.
* Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance and wellness programs.
* A culture that values innovation and promotes a work\-life balance.


****Equal Opportunity Employer****
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.
   

  

**This job description provides a comprehensive outline designed to attract highly technical product managers looking to advance their careers in the dynamic and growing software\-defined vehicle industry. Adjustments can be made based on the specific needs of your team and changes in business strategies.**
