description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
 Deloitte Cyber helps clients navigate an increasingly complex and fast\-changing threat landscape. We simplify complexity, strengthen resilience, and enable organizations to grow with confidence while proactively managing cybersecurity risk.
   

  

**The Team**
 Deloitte’s Cyber Engineering team is building the technology foundation for the next generation of cybersecurity services. We bring together product thinking, engineering depth, and cybersecurity domain expertise to design and deploy modern platforms and AI\-enabled solutions for our clients. Join us as we build future\-ready capabilities with technologies shaping the future of Cybersecurity.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 As a
 **Cyber Forward Deployed Engineering Manager** 
 , you will operate at the intersection of client delivery, engineering execution, and solution shaping. You will lead cross\-functional teams to design, build, and deploy high\-quality cybersecurity and AI\-enabled solutions in client environments. This role requires strong technical depth, delivery ownership, and the ability to translate ambiguous business and cybersecurity needs into scalable, production\-ready solutions.
   

  

 You will be expected to manage workstreams end\-to\-end, guide architecture and engineering decisions, mentor engineers, and engage directly with client stakeholders to drive outcomes. You will also play a key role in pursuits, prototypes, and product feedback loops that shape reusable capabilities across Deloitte’s Cyber Engineering offerings.
   

  

**Must\-Have Skills**
**Core Engineering \& Architecture**
* 9–15 years of hands\-on experience in software engineering, including meaningful experience leading full\-stack engineering teams and complex technical deliveries.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, or Next.js.
* Strong backend development experience in Node.js, Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI), or Java (Spring Boot).
* Experience designing and delivering scalable applications using relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL technologies (e.g., MongoDB, Redis).
* Deep experience building and integrating REST APIs, microservices, event\-driven services, and serverless architectures.
* Experience architecting and deploying cloud\-native applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Strong familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Git\-based workflows, and engineering lifecycle tools such as Azure DevOps or GitHub.
* Ability to make sound architecture decisions, evaluate trade\-offs, and enforce engineering quality, security, and maintainability standards.


**AI / GenAI Capabilities**
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building and deploying GenAI, LLM, or agentic AI solutions in client, enterprise, or production environments.
* Experience with at least one frontier GenAI platform such as Anthropic, Google, or OpenAI, including hands\-on use of products such as Claude API, Claude Code, Gemini API, Vertex AI Agent Builder, Grounding, GPT\-4o, Responses API, Assistants API, or OpenAI Agents SDK.
* Strong understanding of AI application architectures, including orchestration, grounding, prompt workflows, model integration, evaluation, security, and operationalization.
* Ability to align application design and engineering pipelines to support AI\-enabled use cases in secure, scalable production settings.


**Client Leadership \& Delivery Ownership**
* Proven ability to independently lead defined workstreams or products end\-to\-end with high\-quality, timely delivery.
* Experience working directly with senior business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into architecture, roadmaps, and delivered solutions.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts, risks, dependencies, and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated experience leading engineers, reviewing designs and code, and driving accountability across delivery teams.
* Strong ownership mindset with a focus on client outcomes, delivery rigor, and continuous improvement.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Familiarity with cybersecurity domains such as application security, cloud security, identity, SOC engineering, detection engineering, or cyber analytics.
* Experience in product engineering or platform engineering environments.
* Experience with DevSecOps practices and secure software development lifecycle.
* Exposure to search and analytics platforms such as Elasticsearch/OpenSearch and graph databases such as Neo4j.
* Experience with Kubernetes, GitOps, infrastructure as code, and advanced cloud\-native engineering patterns.
* Cloud certifications across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
* Experience supporting proposals, technical demos, proofs of concept, or early\-stage solution shaping in consulting or client\-facing environments.


**Work You Will Do**
* Solution Delivery \& Engineering Leadership
* Lead the design, development, and deployment of high\-quality cybersecurity and AI\-enabled solutions aligned to client requirements, enterprise architecture, and security expectations.
* Own technical delivery across one or more workstreams, including planning, architecture, issue resolution, quality management, and execution oversight.
* Guide engineering teams through solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-launch stabilization.
* Identify technical risks, delivery dependencies, and design trade\-offs early, and drive mitigation plans to maintain delivery confidence.
* Establish and uphold engineering best practices across code quality, documentation, testing, observability, and security.
* Client Engagement \& Solution Shaping
* Partner with client stakeholders to define technical approaches, clarify requirements, and shape pragmatic, scalable solutions to cybersecurity challenges.
* Support pursuits and pre\-sales efforts through technical storytelling, demos, prototypes, architecture inputs, and feasibility assessments.
* Influence solution direction by balancing client priorities, engineering practicality, cybersecurity requirements, and reusable platform opportunities.
* Act as a trusted technical leader who can bridge business goals and engineering execution.
* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
* Mentor and develop engineers through coaching, design reviews, and day\-to\-day delivery leadership.
* Promote a strong team culture centered on accountability, collaboration, learning, and engineering excellence.
* Help teams adopt delivery discipline, reusable patterns, and effective operating rhythms to improve execution quality and speed.
* Product Feedback \& Continuous Improvement
* Capture delivery insights and translate them into reusable product, platform, or engineering improvements.
* Distinguish between client\-specific customization and scalable enhancements that can strengthen Deloitte’s broader Cyber Engineering capabilities.
* Enable client teams and internal teams through structured knowledge transfer, practical documentation, and durable runbooks.


**Education**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. *Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
 Senior Specialist Product Manager
   

  

 Senior Product Manager, Business Experimentation \& Optimization
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing cutting\-edge products and services that help our customers. Focused on thinking big and scaling quickly around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end\-to\-end solutions for a diverse global customer base including issuers, acquirers, and merchants. Centered on data\-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments\-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation (Test \& Learn), and data\-driven information and risk management services.
   

  

 As a member of the Business Experimentation Product Management team, you will build industry\-leading experimentation software which brings sophisticated analytic techniques to businesses and users around the world. We are rapidly building new products, evolving products in the age of AI, and expanding the ways we deliver Test \& Learn to our clients. We are looking for AI native PMs who can execute and evolve our product strategy and help us build the AI enhanced version of Test \& Learn.
   

  

 Role

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**About Druva**
 Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud\-native SaaS platform that delivers air\-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on\-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph\-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.
   

  

 Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.
   

  

 Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The SaaS Apps product line is a significant revenue generator for Druva with massive expansion and growth plans in the near term. With the explosion in AI and the implications for data protection, data governance, identity and security, many key Druva initiatives are being driven out of the SaaS Apps team. This is a key role with major scope and will provide opportunity for immediate impact and company\-wide visibility. The candidate will gain valuable experience in a hyper\-growth startup and develop key career skills on driving a growing product to product\-market fit and SaaS go\-to\-market.
   

  

**Role Purpose \& Impact**
 This is a field and customer\-facing product management role which acts as a strategic partner to senior leadership, influencing product direction and aligning the SaaS roadmap with company objectives. You will collaborate with our cross\-functional customer\-facing teams to interact with our growing customer base to understand their data protection, security and governance needs and bring back insights and ideas for Druva’s roadmap.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Explore new product features, concepts and develop comprehensive market/product requirements across SaaS applications
* Sales, Customer interaction for product demos, roadmap presentations, product feedback and escalations
* Analyze business metrics to develop insights for product go\-to\-market activities and execute on them in collaboration with product marketing, sales
* Work with product managers and product marketing team to build key product marketing collateral and deliver field sales team training
* Analyze product telemetry to develop insights for product roadmap and drive product adoption
* Respond to industry analyst questionnaires, surveys and develop analyst facing presentations


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* 8\+ years of total professional experience building and shipping B2B SaaS products, with at least 5 years of functional product management experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, MBA would be a plus
* Experience working in the data protection domain, particularly in the Microsoft ecosystem (M365, Copilot, D365, Intune)
* Experience with other major SaaS platforms (Google, Salesforce, ServiceNow) a major plus
* Experience with Identity infrastructure (Entra ID, Okta, Active Directory) a major plus


**Highly technical background with an ability to dive deep into products, technology, UX**
* Excellent product sense with an ability/empathy to deeply focus on customer pain points, workflows and an ability to articulate the same
* Highly analytical with an ability to understand metrics, develop a data driven point\-of\-view


**Excellent PM Presence With Clear Written, Verbal Communication Skills**
* Track record of iterating, taking ownership and driving products from concept to execution
* Experience working in high growth, startup environments, with a can\-do attitude


**What Success Looks Like In The Role**
* Ensure customer success through strategic leadership, operational excellence, and collaboration with cross\-functional teams
* Establish strong relationships with customers and partners in order to drive outside\-in thinking across the organization
* Identify new business opportunities based on deep understanding of customer needs, competitive offerings, and Druva’s unique value proposition
* Drive planning and execution of new high\-profile products to support revenue growth.
* Enable the sales and technical sales teams so that they can successfully sell products and deliver maximum ROI for customers
* Mentor and guide junior product managers, fostering a culture of best\-practice sharing.
* Lead the discovery and definition of long\-term product strategy, translating market trends and deep customer insights into actionable, multi\-quarter roadmaps.


**Why You’ll Love Working Here**
 Innovation is how we operate, not a side project. You’ll work in a culture that values bold thinking and continuous improvement, where global teams experiment, iterate, and turn new ideas into products customers can rely on.
   

  

 If you’re looking for high\-ownership work, visible impact, and a culture that values innovation, collaboration, accountability, and growth—where you’ll be trusted to lead and empowered to build—you’ll thrive at Druva.

title: Product Owner
description:
**About Tripstack**
 Founded in Toronto, Canada in 2016, Tripstack has been part of Etraveli Group since 2019\. It is a B2B Flights as a Service provider and a world leader in virtual interlining.
   

  

 Operating from offices in Canada, India, and Poland, Tripstack is the gateway into Etraveli Group’s world leading tech platform \- giving partners access to global flight content, virtual interlining, and a full suite of services including payments, fraud prevention, pricing, and customer support. As a world leader in virtual interlining technology, Tripstack connects non\-partner, low\-cost and full\-service carriers, enabling the creation of unique and flexible itineraries through a simple, cost\-effective API.
   

  

 Its technology ingest over 30B price points and handles over 240 million searches daily.
   

  

 Through partnerships with airlines, OTAs, and other distribution channels across the globe, Tripstack expands networks, drives new revenue streams, and offers more choice at competitive prices, all backed by robust technology and traveler protection.
   

  

 For more information, visit:
   

  

 www.tripstack.com
   

  

 www.etraveligroup.com
   

  

 The role
   

  

 As a Product Owner at Tripstack, you'll report into a Product Manager serving as an operational leader and product strategist for your portfolio within the Content Acquisition team.
   

  

 You will oversee the integration and operation of flight content into our platform, ensuring we maintain world\-leading content at the highest possible quality while keeping our systems stable and performant.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

**Operational Leadership \& Incident Management**
* Own end\-to\-end operational performance of your assigned content portfolio (APIs, consolidators, or scrapes), ensuring system stability, SLA adherence, and production health
* Lead incident management and structured RCA (root cause analysis) investigations for any issues; drive resolution tracking and prevention of recurring production issues
* Define, monitor, and proactively manage operational KPIs: uptime, latency, booking failures, error rates, conversion impact, and portfolio risks
* Act as primary operational escalation point for airline\-related issues, coordinating rapidly across engineering, product teams, and external airline partners


**Cross\-Functional Coordination \& Priority Management**
* Facilitate resource planning and allocation decisions with your engineering team; identify constraints and trade\-offs
* Manage the balance between competing priorities (new feature development, production support, incident response, and ad\-hoc requests)
* Define and communicate clear priorities to engineering teams \- including what gets deprioritized and why
* Coordinate all team standups, sprint planning, ROMs (Rough Order of Magnitude reviews), and alignment meetings
* Track dependencies, blockers, and risks; escalate appropriately and coordinate cross\-team resolution
* Monitor sprint velocity, deliverables, and team output; continuously optimize processes for delivery efficiency


**Stakeholder Alignment \& Communication**
* Align internal stakeholders (engineering, product leadership, data teams) and external partners (Etraveli Group, airlines, consolidators) around priorities, timelines, and expectations
* Communicate operational status, KPIs, and business decisions clearly and concisely \- orally and in writing
* Facilitate regular sync meetings with engineering leadership, other product teams, and stakeholders
* Prepare status reports, milestone updates, and analytics dashboards for leadership visibility


**Product Definition \& Requirements**
* Translate high\-level business objectives and customer needs into clear, well\-documented product requirements and user stories
* Define acceptance criteria and work with QA to establish test cases
* Establish acceptance criteria and work with QA teams to build comprehensive test cases
* Create reusable components and standardized approaches across recipe integrations to improve quality and reduce duplicative work


**Strategic Analysis \& Decision\-Making**
* Conduct data\-backed analysis to inform prioritization decisions; evaluate impact against business value
* Work with architects, engineering managers, and product leaders to assess technical feasibility and design efficient solutions
* Identify opportunities for improvement in security, CI/CD, quality, and performance practices
* Monitor KPIs tied to product decisions and iterate based on results
* Root cause analysis of systemic product issues and recommend structural improvements


**Partnership with Engineering \& Architecture**
* Collaborate with engineering leads on solution architecture, ensuring alignment between product vision and technical implementation
* Work with platform and engineering teams to identify and resolve technical blockers
* Support architecture decisions that balance speed of delivery with long\-term platform health


 Job Requirements
   

  

* 3\+ years hands\-on experience in a product or program management role with significant operational responsibility
* Strong project management and organizational skills with ability to juggle multiple competing priorities
* Excellent communication skills across technical teams, product teams, and non\-technical stakeholders
* Strategic thinker with strong experience in data\-backed decision making
* Comfort with ambiguity; ability to move fast and make decisions with incomplete information
* Leadership skills: ability to bring teams together toward a common purpose and coordinate across multiple teams


**Technical \& Industry Knowledge**
* Knowledge of software architecture, REST, cloud platforms, platform engineering, and microservices
* Experience working as a hands\-on QA engineer or application developer would be advantageous
* Travel industry experience \- particularly with airline APIs, NDC standards, or GDS/PSS systems
* Experience building airline or flight content integrations
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, monitoring tools, and production observability platforms


**Personal Attributes**
* Output and delivery driven; results\-oriented mindset
* Resilient with ability to thrive under pressure and competing demands
* Proficient in communication: clear, concise, and professional across contexts
* Passion for problem\-solving, root cause analysis, and operational excellence
* Highly accountable team player; takes ownership of outcomes


**Benefits**
 We offer an opportunity to work with a young, dynamic, and a growing team composed of high\-caliber professionals. We value professionalism and promote a culture where individuals are encouraged to do more and be more. If you feel you share our passion for excellence, and growth, then look no further. We have an ambitious mission, and we need a world\-class team to make it a reality. Upgrade to a First Class team!
   

  

 At Tripstack, we proudly believe in embracing diversity. This is true for our team, clients, communities and stakeholders. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating a safe, healthy and accessible environment. We encourage applications regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or any other grounds protected by law. Please let us know if you need any accommodations during any part of the recruitment process.
   

  

 Tripstack thanks all applicants for their interest, however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.
   

  

 Learn more about us at www.tripstack.com

SFL Scientific is part of Deloitte’s AI strategy, data science, and engineering practice.  We serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices, using the state\-of\-the\-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design , implement and scale novel solutions that drive value.
   

  

 But we don’t stop at client impact. We are equally passionate about investing in our people. You'll have the opportunity to work across industries, engage directly with senior client stakeholders, and develop expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and business transformation.

We work with clients to identify where AI can create advantage, shape AI and data strategy, design scalable operating models, and partner with technical teams to bring priority AI and data science initiatives to life.


 Strategy professionals serve as trusted advisors to our clients, helping them make clear, data\-driven choices about where to play, how to win, and how to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise.
   

  

**Work you will do:**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, and driving enterprise transformation. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you will:
   

  

* Provide strategic directions to clients on how to leverage Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and enterprise value.

* Identify and prioritize high\-impact AI and GenAI use cases, develop business cases, and define value realization pathways.
* Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility.

description:

 Blue Dot Transform Consulting is a private limited company based out of pune. It works in multiple domain \- training \& Coaching, e\-commerce, alternative healing modalities.
   

  

 For the e\-commerce brand \- Divine Heals, we are currently hiring a growth manager.
   

  

 Divine Heals is a D2C spiritual products brand — The brand sells crystals, Rudraksha, essential oils, and combination bracelets, with a post\-purchase journey designed to move customers into Charu's coaching programmes.
   

  

 The brand is live, growing, and generating revenue. What it does not yet have is an operational system that can scale without the founder or the business head being pulled into execution daily.
   

  

 This role exists to build that system — and then run it.
   

 You will own the full operations function of Divine Heals.
   

  

 Shopify, fulfillment, inventory, post\-purchase flows, WhatsApp automation, SOPs, vendor management, customer experience, and the backend processes that make the business work without someone manually holding everything together.
   

  

 The marketing strategy and content are handled. Charu remains the face of the brand. Your job is to make sure everything behind the face works.
   

  

 What you will own
   

  

 Shopify and store operations
   

  

 Product page quality — descriptions, imagery formatting, size guides, care instructions, trust elements
   

  

 Inventory management — stock tracking, reorder triggers, low\-stock alerts
   

  

 Checkout experience — friction reduction, GoKwik integration performance, cart abandonment flows
   

 New product launches — end\-to\-end coordination from product briefing to live listing
   

  

 Pricing and offer architecture — seasonal promotions, bundle logic, prepaid incentives
   

 Fulfilment and logistics
   

  

 Shadowfax and XpressBees coordination — daily dispatch, exception handling, return management
   

 Shipping policy — SLA adherence, delay communication to customers, escalation handling
   

  

 COD to prepaid conversion — building incentive structures and checkout nudges to shift the ratio
   

 Customer experience
   

  

 Post\-purchase WhatsApp sequence — building and managing the 14\-day nurture flow in Charu's voice that moves buyers toward the Level I coaching programme
   

  

 Query handling SOP — standard responses, escalation paths, response time standards
   

 Review and testimonial system — collection, verification, and deployment across Shopify and social
   

  

 Automation and systems
   

  

 WhatsApp automation via QuickReply.ai — flows, triggers, campaign sequences

 CRM or tracking system — building a basic customer record so follow\-up is systematic, not memory\-based
   

 SOPs and documentation
   

  

 Every operational process documented — written down, version\-controlled, and accessible to the team
   

 Onboarding new team members into the Divine Heals operational workflow
   

  

 Monthly operations report — inventory status, fulfilment metrics, customer satisfaction indicators, open issues
   

  

  

  

 What we are looking for
   

 Non\-negotiable
   

  

 4\-5 years of hands\-on D2C operations experience — you have worked inside a D2C brand and you know what it takes to run one, not just advise one
   

 Shopify proficiency — you can manage products, collections, discounts, apps, and basic theme edits without needing a developer for everything
   

 Experience building or managing post\-purchase flows — WhatsApp, email, or both
   

 SOPs mindset — you document what you build. If it only exists in your head, it does not exist.
   

  

  

  

 Strong advantage
   

  

 Experience in spiritual, wellness, or lifestyle D2C categories — you understand the customer and the purchase psychology
   

  

 Familiarity with QuickReply.ai or similar WhatsApp business automation tools
   

  

 Experience managing logistics partners — Shadowfax, XpressBees, Shiprocket, or equivalent
   

 Understanding of COD\-heavy D2C operations in India — prepaid conversion strategies, RTO reduction, return management
   

  

 Experience with GoKwik or similar checkout optimisation tools

* Evaluating problems;

 Reports to the Associate Manager of the Display Quote team.

HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024\).
   

  

 HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward\-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI\-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best\-in\-class AI\-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.
   

  

**HackerOne Values**
 HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is
 **Customer Obsessed** 
 and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We
 **Default to Disclosure** 
 by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners
 **Win Together** 
 by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.
   

  

**Product Manager, Agentic Vulnerability Elimination**
 Location: Pune, India (In\-office)
   

  

 Working timing : UK Shift
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 HackerOne is seeking a hands\-on, technically curious Product Manager to join the team building Agentic Vulnerability Elimination (AVE). AVE is how HackerOne brings AI agents and human expertise together to validate, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities at scale. The agents do the heavy lifting on every finding, while our triage analysts and security researchers keep them accurate and trustworthy. In this role, you will drive improvements to the quality and performance of these agents and the harness they run in, working closely with our Pune triage and offensive security teams and partnering closely with product development teams based in India, the Netherlands, and the U.K.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for someone who is energized by AI, comfortable getting into the details of how an agent actually behaves, and motivated by close collaboration with the operators, security researchers, and customers who use and pressure\-test our products every day.
   

  

 This hybrid role is located in Pune, India, and reports to the Principal Product Manager for Agentic Vulnerability Elimination.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
 Success in the Product Manager role will be accomplished by delivering on the responsibilities below in alignment with the Values and Principles that define how we work at HackerOne:
   

  

* Lead the definition and delivery of improvements to AI agent quality, performance, and cost management across validation, prioritization, exploitation, deduplication, and remediation, balancing model capabilities, operational workflows, customer outcomes, and engineering tradeoffs.
* Own the evolution of the evaluation framework and agent harness, establishing scalable evaluation methodologies, quality gates, and feedback loops that improve agentic capabilities over time.
* Partner with triage, engineering, offensive security researchers, and product teams to align priorities, influence product direction, and translate operational workflows into scalable, AI\-driven product capabilities.
* Work closely with our offensive security researchers to validate exploitability, adversarially stress\-test agent decisions, and improve how the agents reason about real\-world attack scenarios.
* Partner with customer\-facing teams in EMEA and the US to join customer calls and understand user workflows, gather feedback, and keep agent improvements grounded in real\-world needs.
* Define the product health metrics for your area, design experimentation frameworks, and use evidence to make prioritization decisions that improve customer and business outcomes.
* Own significant product initiatives, independently defining problem statements, success metrics, and execution plans while influencing the broader product strategy alongside senior product leadership and partnering closely with development teams based in India, the Netherlands, and the U.K.
* Navigate ambiguous product problems where customer needs, AI capabilities, and security workflows are still emerging, bringing structure, prioritization, and clear execution plans to cross\-functional teams.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of product management experience, ideally on technical or AI/LLM products at high\-growth tech or SaaS companies.
* A track record of building products with close cross\-functional collaboration across engineering, design, and operations.
* Hands\-on experience with LLM\-based solutions, including prompting, evaluations, quality control, and the practical realities of building features on top of generative AI.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort working directly with data to define metrics, run experiments, and make decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build alignment among technical and operational staff.
* Experience working with distributed/async product development teams in different time zones.
* Based in Pune or willing to relocate, and able to work on\-site there on a hybrid basis.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience building agentic systems, evaluation pipelines, agent harnesses, or human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity, vulnerability management, DevSecOps, or bug bounty and penetration testing.
* Prior experience working closely with an operations or triage team, or directly with security researchers.
* Comfort with SQL or light scripting to pull and analyze your own data.

title: Customer Data Mastering Technology Lead/Senior Associate Director
description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering**
 A seasoned and strategic Technology Lead – Customer Data Mastering Service (CDMS) to lead the design, product management, planning and development, operation, and evolution of the bank’s global customer mastering platform. CDMS plays a foundational role in enabling a unified view of customers across all lines of business by managing a single global customer identifier and maintaining customer data as a trusted source of truth.
   

  

 As part of the Reference Data Technology domain, this role is accountable for the full lifecycle of customer mastering – including data capture during prospecting and onboarding, lifecycle management, change monitoring using external data, and provisioning to consuming applications through Enterprise Data Products, standard APIs, and event\-driven integrations.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact leadership role interfacing across business, technology, CDAO, and regulatory stakeholders to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant customer data management at global scale.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Lead the technology platform embedding for Customer Data Mastering Services (CDMS) for UK.
* Ensure creation and ongoing management of the UK customer identifier during onboarding and throughout the customer lifecycle. Design and govern data mastering rules, and golden record formation to establish a consistent, high\-quality customer truth.
* Deliver platform capabilities for UK customer data change monitoring using internal and external data sources.
* Oversee provisioning of UK mastered customer data to consuming systems through standardized APIs, EDAs, and event\-based patterns. Ensure platform scalability, resilience, and compliance across global markets, adhering to data localization and privacy regulations.
* Partner with CRM, KYC, onboarding, digital, CDAO, and risk stakeholders to meet critical UK business and regulatory use cases.Embed data governance, metadata management, lineage, and control mechanisms to support audits, lineage, and data usage transparency.
* Drive architectural modernization, automation, and cloud\-readiness of the CDMS platform.
* Lead one end to end team or product managers, analysts, engineering and design teams along with vendor partners to create, maintain and deliver on roadmap priorities with agility, security, and operational discipline.
* Represent CDMS in enterprise forums, data councils, and regulatory reviews where customer data mastering is a focus. Act as India entity lead of Customer Data tech.


**To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requireme** 
 nts:
   

  

* 15\+ years of experience in platform product management, data engineering, platform development, or enterprise technology roles, preferably within customer or identity data domains.Strong expertise in customer data mastering, identity resolution, golden record management, and integration frameworks.
* Good experience in retail / consumer banking, and support UK market and regulations. Practical experience of designing master data solutions, particularly around non\-functional, data entitlement and auditing requirements.Deep understanding of enterprise data architecture, API platforms, event\-driven systems, and metadata\-driven design. Hands\-on experience with data service design (APIs, e.g. REST and event messaging), and data quality tooling.
* Familiarity with data privacy, localization, and regulatory frameworks relevant to customer data (e.g., FATCA, KYC/CDD regulations). Experience of solving the challenge of global solutions in a complex data residency environment.
* Proven ability to lead global teams and deliver complex platforms that serve multiple lines of business and regions. Track record of delivering business\-aligned solutions using data that support customer lifecycle, onboarding, and risk management processes.
* Essential Capabilities: Cultivates Innovation: Creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful. Strategic Mindset: Seeing ahead to future possibilities and translating them into breakthrough strategies.
* Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm. Builds Effective Teams: Building strong\-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals
* Drives Vision \& Purpose: Painting a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others to action. Being Resilient: Rebounding from setbacks and adversity when facing difficult situations. Manages ambiguity and ensures accountability: Operating effectively, even when things are not certain, or the way forward is not clear; holds self and others accountable to meet commitments.
* Persuasion \& Conviction: Using compelling arguments to gain the support and commitment of others; stepping up to address difficult issues and saying what needs to be said


 You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. title: Manager - Customer Interaction Suite
description:
**About The Company**
 Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
   

  

 A
 **Technical Program Manager (TPM)** 
 is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end delivery of complex technology programs, including
 **product development, deployment, and lifecycle management** 
 for communication platforms such as
 **SMS, WhatsApp, Email, RCS and Voice solutions** 
 . The role acts as a bridge between Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success teams to ensure successful implementation and adoption of products.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Drive the planning, execution, and delivery of technical programs and product initiatives.
* Manage the complete product lifecycle for SMS, WhatsApp Business, Email, and Voice communication platforms.
* Lead product deployment, implementation, onboarding, and rollout activities across customers and internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Product, Operations, Security, Compliance, and Business teams to deliver solutions on time.


**Define program scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics.**
* Manage customer integrations, platform migrations, and deployment strategies.
* Identify and mitigate risks, resolve blockers, and ensure smooth execution.
* Track program KPIs, adoption metrics, service performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Drive process improvements, automation, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Provide executive\-level reporting and stakeholder communication.


**Required Skills**
* Strong program and project management experience.
* Good understanding of CPaaS (Communications Platform as a Service) products including SMS, WhatsApp Business API, Email, and Voice solutions.
* Experience managing product deployments, customer implementations, and platform integrations.
* Knowledge of APIs, cloud platforms, system architecture, and enterprise software delivery.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, and product development methodologies.
* Excellent problem\-solving, risk management, and analytical abilities.


**Success Metrics**
* Successful delivery and deployment of communication products.
* On\-time program execution and customer go\-live completion.
* Platform adoption and utilization growth.
* Service reliability, uptime, and operational efficiency.
* Customer satisfaction and business impact.
* Effective management of risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.


**One\-line Summary**
 A TPM drives the development, deployment, and adoption of
 **SMS, WhatsApp, Email, and Voice products** 
 , ensuring seamless execution of technical programs, customer implementations, and business outcomes across cross\-functional teams.
